title: Executive Assistant
description:
The Nabo Group is looking for a responsible, dynamic, organized, detail oriented, and reliable Executive Assistant to work closely with the company's President.



The Executive Assistant to the President provides high-level administrative support to the President, ensuring efficient operation and communication within the executive office. This role involves managing calendar and other schedules, coordinating meetings, travel arrangements, handling correspondence, and performing a variety of tasks to facilitate the President's ability to lead the organization effectively. The Executive Assistant acts as a liaison between the President and internal/external stakeholders, maintaining confidentiality and professionalism at all times. This remote position requires exceptional organizational skills, proactive problem-solving abilities, to be available when needed and the capacity to work independently while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.



Key Responsibilities:



- Administrative support, meeting scribing, data collection, tracker maintenance, communication management, and weekly executive reporting to support our accounting department transition.

- Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact between the President and internal/external stakeholders, handling correspondence, phone calls, and
s.

- Meeting Coordination: Organize and prepare for meetings, including drafting agendas, taking minutes, and following up on action items.

- Document Management: Prepare, review, and manage documents, reports, and presentations for the President.

- Project Support: Assist with special projects, research, and data analysis as needed, ensuring timely completion and accuracy.

- Confidentiality: Maintain the highest level of confidentiality and discretion in handling sensitive information.

- Task Prioritization: Prioritize and manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously, ensuring deadlines are met.

- Administrative Support: Provide general administrative support, including filing, expense reporting, and office supply management.

- Problem-Solving: Proactively identify and address issues that may impact the President's ability to lead effectively.

- Relationship Management: Build and maintain positive relationships with key stakeholders, both internally and externally.

- Compliance: Review contracts, agreements, and other legally-binding documents. Assist also with the Community Association Institute (CAI).



Qualifications:



- At least 3 years of experience as a remote Executive Assistant, preferably from a US-based real-estate or property management firm.

- Proficiency in using office software (MS Office Suite, Google Suite, etc.) and other project management tools.

- Ability to manage and organize
 correspondence efficiently.

- Ability to communicate effectively with internal and external clients in different levels, handle inquiries, and resolve issues.

- Experience in general admin tasks (preparing documents, handling expenses, maintaining records, travel management, etc.).

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills as the position will represent the firm professionally and respond adeptly to various situations.



Working Conditions:

- This is a fully remote position. Applicants must meet certain requirements for a working computer and consent to our IT department conducting an analysis of the computer for cybersecurity and safety purposes.



Expected Work Times:

- Candidates are generally expected to work during U.S. Eastern Standard Time (EST) business hours.

- The candidate must be available during working hours for meetings and accessible by phone/text during the workday.

- Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:30 PM EST (with a 30-minute unpaid break)



Time Tracking:

- Use of Hubstaff time-tracking software is required while performing work.



* This is a full-time contract position. Payments are made via Wise on the 15th and 30th of each month. While this is a contractor role, we do offer a variety of perks for our contractors.

title: Graphic Designer & Video Editor
description:
Company: Engage Pickleball

Location: Philippines (Remote)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Schedule: Monday–Friday, Eastern Time

Compensation: $275.00 USD per Week 



ABOUT THE ROLE



Engage Pickleball is seeking a creative, detail-oriented Graphic Designer & Video Editor to support our marketing, e-commerce, and brand development initiatives.



This position combines graphic design, video editing, and digital content production. The ideal candidate can transform raw footage, product photography, and creative concepts into polished, professional marketing materials that strengthen our brand and drive customer engagement.



We are looking for someone who understands modern design trends, visual storytelling, and digital marketing while maintaining a clean, premium, and consistent brand identity.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Video Editing & Production



- Edit short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok,
, and YouTube Shorts.

- Produce longer-form videos, including product demonstrations, promotional videos, tutorials, interviews, and educational content.

- Create product launch videos, advertisements, and promotional campaigns.

- Add captions, transitions, music, sound effects, motion graphics, and animations.

- Improve video quality through color correction, audio enhancement, and professional editing techniques.

- Repurpose existing footage into multiple formats for different platforms.

- Maintain organized video files, project assets, and completed deliverables.



2. Graphic Design & Marketing Materials



- Design professional graphics for social media, websites,
 campaigns, and digital advertisements.

- Create product launch graphics, promotional banners, and campaign materials.

- Design product catalogs, brochures, flyers, presentations, and other marketing collateral.

- Edit and enhance product photography, including background removal, retouching, and image composition.

- Develop e-commerce graphics, product feature visuals, and comparison charts.

- Prepare digital and print-ready files with accurate sizing, resolution, and formatting.

- Maintain consistency with Engage's brand guidelines across all materials.



3. E-Commerce & Product Content



- Create visually compelling product images for Shopify, Amazon, eBay, and other marketplaces.

- Develop graphics highlighting product features, technologies, and benefits.

- Support new product launches with coordinated video and graphic assets.

- Optimize images and video formats for websites, marketplaces, and mobile devices.



4. Creative Development & Collaboration



- Work with the marketing and management teams to develop creative concepts.

- Research current design trends, video formats, and competitor content.

- Recommend creative improvements to strengthen brand presentation and marketing performance.

- Manage multiple assignments while meeting established deadlines.

- Incorporate feedback efficiently and maintain accurate project status updates.



QUALIFICATIONS



Required:



- Previous professional experience in both graphic design and video editing.

- Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality graphic design and video work.

- Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, or comparable professional design software.

- Experience using Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or similar video-editing software.

- Strong understanding of typography, composition, branding, and visual storytelling.

- Ability to edit both short-form and long-form videos.

- Experience creating social media and digital marketing content.

- Strong attention to detail, organization, and time management.

- Excellent written English communication skills.

- Ability to work independently, follow creative briefs, and meet deadlines.

- Reliable internet connection and computer capable of professional video editing.



Preferred:



- Experience with Adobe After Effects and motion graphics.

- Experience creating e-commerce product graphics and advertising creatives.

- Familiarity with Shopify, Amazon, or other online marketplaces.

- Experience designing print catalogs and promotional materials.

- Experience with AI-assisted creative tools.

- Interest in sports, fitness, or pickleball.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We value creativity, accountability, efficiency, and consistent execution.



The successful candidate should be able to take a creative brief, develop a professional finished product, and deliver it with minimal supervision.



We want someone who can contribute original ideas, identify opportunities for improvement, and produce content that reflects a premium sporting goods brand.



WORK SCHEDULE & EXPECTATIONS



This is a full-time remote position, Monday through Friday, operating on Eastern Time (ET), with two available shift options:



- 8:00 AM–4:00 PM ET

- 9:00 AM–5:00 PM ET



Team members are required to participate in a daily Google Meet workspace throughout their scheduled shift, with cameras enabled. This shared virtual workspace promotes real-time collaboration, accessible support, efficient communication, and a connected team environment.



Employees are expected to maintain consistent productivity, meet assigned performance standards, complete tasks accurately, and communicate proactively with management.



We value accountability, reliability, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following in your application:



1. A link to your graphic design portfolio.

2. A link to your video-editing portfolio, including both short-form and long-form examples.

3. The software and creative tools you regularly use.

4. Your earliest available start date.



Portfolio submissions are required. Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a paid practical assessment to demonstrate their design and video-editing capabilities.



We are looking for a dependable, creative professional interested in a long-term opportunity with Engage Pickleball.

title: KDP Publishing & Book Marketing Manager
description:
About the Role



We are seeking a highly skilled, creative, and results-driven KDP Publishing & Book Marketing Manager to oversee the publishing, promotion, and growth of fiction books, particularly in the psychological thriller and suspense genres.



The ideal candidate has a proven track record of successfully marketing and selling books on Amazon, managing advertising campaigns, and executing effective strategies to increase book visibility, readership, and profitability.



This is not simply a book uploading or administrative role. We are looking for someone who understands how to turn published books into commercially successful products through strategic marketing, compelling content, and data-driven decision-making.



You will manage the publishing process from manuscript preparation to launch while developing and executing ongoing marketing campaigns.



Key Responsibilities

1. Book Marketing & Amazon Advertising (Primary Focus)

- Develop and execute marketing strategies to increase book sales, readership, and visibility.

- Manage and optimize Amazon Ads campaigns, including automatic, keyword, and product-targeting advertisements.

- Monitor advertising budgets, campaign performance, costs, sales, and estimated royalties to evaluate profitability.

- Research relevant book categories, keywords, competing titles, and target audiences.

- Optimize Amazon book listings, descriptions, metadata, and discoverability.

- Write persuasive book descriptions, promotional copy, advertising headlines, and
 campaigns.

- Develop marketing strategies for book series, backlist titles, and new releases.



2. Social Media & Audience Development

- Create engaging promotional content for TikTok (BookTok), Instagram Reels,
, and YouTube Shorts.

- Develop short-form videos, promotional graphics, and creative marketing materials.

- Identify and collaborate with relevant book influencers, reviewers, and content creators.

- Build and maintain reader
 lists, newsletters, and book launch campaigns.

- Test additional marketing channels and evaluate their effectiveness.



3. Amazon KDP Publishing & Production

- Manage the complete Amazon Kindle Direct Publishing (KDP) process for ebooks and paperbacks.

- Prepare and upload manuscripts, book covers, descriptions, keywords, and publishing metadata.

- Ensure accurate book formatting, layout, navigation, and print specifications.

- Manage Amazon Author Central, A+ Content, book series information, and listing updates.

- Coordinate with editors, designers, and freelancers when necessary.

- Ensure compliance with Amazon KDP publishing, advertising, and content policies.



4. Book Launches & Promotional Campaigns

- Develop and manage book launch timelines, promotional schedules, and advertising plans.

- Coordinate advance reader copies (ARCs) and ethical review-generation strategies.

- Execute pre-launch, launch, and post-launch promotional campaigns.

- Identify opportunities to improve sales performance for existing titles.



5. Editorial Support & Content Development

- Assist with manuscript development, revisions, and content improvements based on provided outlines and instructions.

- Review writing for clarity, consistency, pacing, and reader engagement.

- Provide constructive feedback on book descriptions, covers, and overall market positioning.

- Use AI-assisted tools responsibly while maintaining content quality, originality, and compliance with publishing requirements.



6. Performance Tracking & Reporting

- Track book sales, advertising costs, royalties, and marketing performance.

- Analyze campaign results and recommend improvements.

- Maintain organized publishing records, campaign data, and project timelines.

- Submit weekly progress reports outlining completed tasks, campaign results, spending, challenges, and upcoming priorities.



Required Qualifications

- Proven experience in Amazon KDP publishing and book marketing.

- Demonstrated success marketing and promoting published fiction books.

- Hands-on experience managing and optimizing Amazon Ads campaigns.

- Strong understanding of book marketing strategies, audience targeting, keyword research, and Amazon discoverability.

- Excellent written English with strong copywriting and editorial skills.

- Experience creating engaging social media marketing content and short-form promotional videos.

- Ability to analyze advertising performance, sales reports, and marketing profitability.

- Strong organizational, project management, and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and work independently.

- Proactive, detail-oriented, creative, and results-driven.



Preferred Qualifications

- Experience marketing psychological thrillers, suspense, mystery, or other full-length fiction genres.

- Familiarity with BookTok, Bookstagram, and influencer marketing.

- Experience with
 marketing platforms and reader audience development.



Knowledge of ebook and paperback formatting tools.

- Experience coordinating book cover design and marketing graphics.

- Familiarity with Amazon Author Central and A+ Content.

- Experience using AI-assisted writing and marketing tools.

- Background in fiction writing, manuscript editing, or creative publishing.



What We're Looking For

We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate actual book marketing results, not just experience uploading books to Amazon.



The successful candidate should be able to explain the strategies they implemented, the advertising budgets they managed, and the outcomes they achieved.



We value someone who takes initiative, understands their target readers, communicates effectively, and makes informed marketing decisions based on measurable results.

Life Science Center is seeking a Staff Accountant with strong technical skills in general ledger management, accounts payable/receivable, and compliance with Philippine tax laws and regulatory filings. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, and capable of supporting multi-entity operations while maintaining accuracy and timeliness in financial reporting.



Key Responsibilities



1. General Ledger Management

2. Post journal entries and maintain accurate, up-to-date general ledger accounts.

3. Perform monthly account reconciliations (bank, credit card, intercompany, etc.).

4. Support month-end and year-end closing processes.

5. Accounts Payable & Receivable

6. Process vendor invoices, employee reimbursements, and supplier payments.

7. Ensure proper coding, approvals, and timely settlement of liabilities.

8. Issue client invoices, track collections, and reconcile AR aging.

9. Tax Compliance & Filings: MAP & SAWT, RELIEF, Semestral List of Regular Suppliers

11. Submission of AFS to BIR via ORUS system.

12. Secure and renewal of business registrations & permits with local government and other governing bodies such as but not limited to SEC, BOI, DTI, as necessary.

13. Submission of AFS, GIS, and GFFS to SEC.

14. Maintain organized tax records and schedules to support audits and examinations.

15. Monitor changes in Philippine tax laws and ensure compliance.

16. Reporting & Support

17. Assist in preparing financial statements and management reports.

18. Provide schedules and supporting documents for audits and external reviews.

19. Coordinate with external accountants, auditors, and regulators as required.



Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (CPA preferred but not required).

• Minimum 3 years of accounting experience with emphasis on GL, AP/AR, and Philippine tax compliance.

• Strong working knowledge of BIR processes, deadlines, and eFPS/eBIRForms filing.

• Proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO) or similar ERP/accounting systems.

• Solid understanding of accrual-based accounting and reconciliation best practices.

• High attention to detail, with strong organizational and time management skills.

• Success Metrics

a. All BIR filings submitted 100% on time with no penalties.

b. AP/AR aging maintained within agreed thresholds (e.g., no payables over 30 days without approval, AR collections monitored weekly).

c. Month-end close and reconciliations completed within 7–10 business days.

d. Zero recurring errors in GL postings or reconciliations.

description:
**BER-MONTH HIRING BONUS**

We are happy to offer a $150 USD sign-on bonus in December!





ABOUT SHOP MARKETING PROS:

We are a marketing agency based in the United States with a stateside and international team of 50+ professionals. Shop Marketing Pros is a very well-respected and rapidly growing Digital Marketing Agency in the Automotive Repair Industry with strong core values and a superb track record of serving its clients better than competitors. Our key services include Website Design, Digital Advertising, Search Engine Optimization, and Social Media Management. 



Our Core Values are of incredible importance to us. We live by our “SHIELD” so please visit 
/core-values/ and familiarize yourself with our Core Values and our PRO Team Charter before continuing. Please continue with this job description and application if you feel you align with these values.





COMPANY BENEFITS + PERKS

1) 13th Month Pay

2) Unlimited PTO (after 3 months)

3) HMO of up to $25/month (after 3 months)

4) Eight (8) Paid Holiday Leaves (Filipino Holidays)

5) Paid time off beginning Christmas Eve until New Year’s Day (we plan to continue offering this as long as it is feasible)

6) An extraordinary team/company culture





JOB DESCRIPTION:

Shop Marketing Pros is seeking a detail-oriented Blog Posting Assistant to temporarily support our SEO team. This is a short-term, full-time remote position focused on helping our SEO Specialists with the execution of blog publishing across our clients’ websites. Work hours are from Mon-Fri, 8 am to 4 pm U.S. Central Time.



The primary responsibility of this role is to take completed blog content provided by the SEO team and accurately upload, format, and publish it on client websites. This is an entry-level, execution-focused role and does not require advanced SEO knowledge or content writing experience. The ideal candidate is comfortable working in WordPress and Duda, follows instructions carefully, and can consistently complete repetitive tasks with accuracy and attention to detail. 





REQUIRED SKILLS:

The ideal candidate

Is familiar with posting and formatting blog content in WordPress and Duda

Is comfortable navigating basic WordPress and Duda features and editors

Demonstrates strong attention to detail and can identify formatting or publishing errors

Can accurately follow step-by-step instructions, SOPs, and checklists

Is comfortable formatting headings, paragraphs, lists, links, and images

Is organized and able to work efficiently across multiple client websites

Is dependable and able to complete assigned work accurately and on schedule

Is comfortable performing repetitive, process-driven tasks while maintaining consistent quality

Not Required, but helpful:

Previous experience posting blogs or other website content

Basic understanding of SEO and on-page SEO concepts such as internal/external linking

Experience working with website content workflows or task management systems





JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

Upload completed blog content provided by the SEO team to client WordPress and Duda websites.

Properly format headings, paragraphs, lists, links, images, and other blog elements according to provided instructions and standards.

Complete required blog settings and publishing steps based on established SOPs and checklists.

Review each blog before publishing to identify and correct formatting issues, broken or incorrect links, missing images, and other publishing errors.

Work across multiple client WordPress and Duda websites while ensuring content is posted to the correct website and location.

Follow established SEO team processes, SOPs, naming conventions, and checklists to ensure consistency and accuracy.

Take on routine blog-posting tasks to help SEO Specialists focus on higher-level SEO responsibilities.

INSIDE ROCKET DOCTOR

Rocket Doctor is a cloud-based telehealth company bringing the most advanced doctor’s office into homes across North America. ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an experienced and highly analytical Paid Ads Supervisor to oversee the day-to-day management and optimization of our paid advertising campaigns, primarily across Google Ads, with additional campaigns on Meta, Reddit, and Bing.

You will work closely with Rocket Doctor’s leadership team and digital ads consultant to translate the broader advertising strategy into clear, actionable plans for the Paid Ads team.

Provide guidance, feedback, and support to tea
mbers

title: Tax Accountant
description:
Join a Growing CPA & Advisory Firm Focused on Tax Strategy & Wealth Building



At Liger Zelaya Growth & Tax Advisors, we do more than prepare tax returns. We help business owners, high-income professionals, and real estate investors build long-term wealth through proactive tax planning, accounting, and strategic financial guidance.



We're a family-owned CPA and advisory firm led by Emma Liger Zelaya, CPA, and we're looking for an experienced U.S. Tax Accountant who wants to grow with us and become an integral part of our team.



This is a dedicated, long-term position for someone who is ready to commit their professional time and expertise to our firm. We are not looking for someone who plans to juggle multiple clients or split their working hours across different companies. We want someone who can become familiar with our clients, understand our processes, take ownership of their responsibilities, and grow alongside the firm.



If you enjoy solving complex tax challenges, exploring tax-saving strategies, and working directly with firm leadership, we'd love to meet you.



What You'll Do



- Prepare and review U.S. individual and business tax returns.

- Assist with proactive tax planning and strategic tax advisory engagements.

- Analyze financial information to identify tax-saving opportunities.

- Support multi-state tax compliance and reporting.

- Communicate with clients and assist with tax-related inquiries.

- Work closely with the firm's leadership on client engagements and special projects.

- Help improve internal workflows, processes, and systems as the firm continues to grow.



What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone with at least 2–3 years of hands-on U.S. tax preparation experience, preferably with exposure to both individual and business tax returns.



Required Qualifications:

- At least 2–3 years of U.S. tax preparation experience.

- Hands-on experience with Form 1040, Schedule C, Schedule E, Form 1065, and Form 1120S.

- Solid accounting and tax fundamentals.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to manage multiple client engagements and meet deadlines.

- Willingness to commit to a dedicated, full-time role with our firm.



Preferred Experience:

- QuickBooks, TaxDome, ATX, Drake, ProSeries, CCH, or Canopy.

- Tax research and tax planning tools such as TaxGPT or Juno.

- Experience supporting high-income individuals, business owners, and real estate investors.

- CPA or EA certification is a plus but not required.



Why Join Us?



This isn't your typical tax preparation job.



At Liger Zelaya, you'll have the opportunity to go beyond compliance work and become involved in meaningful tax planning and advisory engagements.



You'll work directly with experienced CPAs and firm leadership, gaining exposure to strategies that help clients make informed financial decisions and build long-term wealth.



We believe in investing in our people. As part of our team, you'll receive:



- Direct mentorship and guidance from experienced CPAs.

- Exposure to complex tax situations and proactive tax strategies.

- Opportunities to take ownership of client relationships and engagements.

- A supportive, family-run working environment.

- Professional development and opportunities to grow into greater responsibilities as the firm expands.



Most importantly, we're looking for someone who wants to build a career with us, not simply complete assignments and move on to the next client.



Compensation & Benefits



- Competitive compensation based on experience.

- Fully remote work environment.

- Dedicated, long-term position with our firm.

- Ongoing mentorship and professional development.

- Performance-based growth opportunities.

- Opportunity to grow with an expanding CPA and advisory firm.



Ready to Grow With Us?



If you have at least 2–3 years of U.S. tax experience and are looking for more than just another tax preparation job, we'd love to hear from you.



Join a growing firm where your expertise, commitment, and contributions can make a meaningful difference.



Interested candidates are invited to submit their updated resume/CV for consideration.

title: Property Accountant (RCG Portfolio)

Today we sell air purifiers (PureFlow), dehumidifiers (DryFlow) and replacement filters to thousands of households through our own webshop, Bol and Amazon. We test every model ourselves before it goes on sale, customers get an answer from a real person every day, and we are rated 4.6 out of 5 on Trustpilot from more than 3,200 reviews. Our products are made by partner factories in China, and we now receive full 40HQ containers every month.



Our mission: healthy air in every home, in every season. We want to grow from the Netherlands and Belgium to more European countries, and over the next 12 to 18 months we are building a team of experienced people, most of them in the Philippines.



You will work directly with the owners, Remco and Johnny, and with our new Team Lead.



THE ROLE

You own our Amazon accounts in Europe, starting with Amazon Netherlands and Germany. You keep the accounts healthy, run PPC and make sure the full catalog is live.

• The full catalog is live on Amazon Netherlands and Germany.

• PPC in Germany runs profitably (TACOS below break-even).

title: Operations Support Specialist
description:
ABOUT TERN



Tern is a venture-backed software company on a mission to reshape the $127B travel agency industry—by giving power back to the entrepreneurs who built it.



Nearly 98% of travel agencies are small businesses. These businesses have been chronically underserved by technology. We're here to change that. Our platform helps travel advisors run more efficient, professional, and profitable operations—giving them the modern infrastructure they need to lead the next chapter of travel.



But the impact goes beyond business. Travel advisors help clients move more intentionally through the world. When a traveler works with an advisor, they're more likely to avoid overtouristed hotspots and more likely to spend their dollars in places where they can do real good. That's the kind of travel we want more of.



At Tern, we believe in small business. We believe in the power of travel. And we're building the future of both.



OPERATIONS SUPPORT SPECIALIST **This role will be supporting US Eastern Time hours**



Tern is growing fast. More events, more people, more invoices, more inboxes. Someone has to keep all of it moving, and right now that work is spread across people who should be spending their time elsewhere.



This role sits behind our events, marketing, and people teams. On a normal Tuesday you might answer a dozen
s in the events inbox, set up next week's advisor office hours, order a laptop for a new hire, chase two missing receipts, and flag a state tax notice that needs action. This is not an executive assistant role. You won't be managing anyone's calendar. You'll own the back-end work that keeps the company running.



The tasks are learnable. The volume is real. We're looking for someone who asks clarifying questions before they start, builds their own system for keeping track, and wants to grow with a company that is scaling quickly.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Run the events inbox. Own the events inbox day to day, and especially in the weeks before and during our bigger events. Answer what you can, route what you can't.

- Set up virtual events. Build and manage webinars, advisor office hours, and hosted virtual events. Handle registrations, links, reminders, and follow-up questions.

-Support in-person events. Research and book restaurants, hotels, and event registrations for the team.

- Run new-hire back-end onboarding. Set up new hires in our HR system, order equipment, provision tool access, and make sure every onboarding checklist gets finished.

- Keep finance admin clean. Track invoices and receipts, monitor the accounting inbox, and help keep event and tool budgets on track.

- Watch the mail and the compliance notices. Sort physical mail and flag state tax and compliance notices (rate changes, filings, registrations) so nothing gets missed.

- Help with recruiting and team moments. Source resumes and help manage the candidate pipeline during hiring pushes. Coordinate monthly birthday and anniversary gifts. You may also support scheduling and running Tern sales demos.



WHAT YOU HAVE



- Operations or admin experience: 2+ years in an operations, admin, or coordinator role where you supported more than one team at once.

- High-volume organization: You've managed a busy shared inbox, a pile of requests, or a recurring process without dropping things. You can show us the system you use.

title: Realistic 3D Human Character Artist
description:
JOB OPPORTUNITY — REALISTIC 3D HUMAN CHARACTER ARTIST



Project: PNTZE — Interactive Education Platform

Position: 3D Human Character Modelling, Facial Likeness, Rigging & Animation Specialist

Location: Remote

Engagement: Project-based, with potential for ongoing work



⸻



IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



We are specifically looking for someone with proven experience creating realistic 3D human characters from photographs, including accurate facial likeness, character rigging and natural animation.



This is NOT a general Blender, graphic design, 2D animation or basic 3D modelling position.



Our highest priorities are:



1. REALISTIC FACIAL LIKENESS — ESSENTIAL



You must have practical experience recreating recognisable human faces in 3D from real photographic references.



This includes:



* Accurate facial proportions, anatomy and symmetry.

* Correct eyes, nose, mouth, cheeks and jawline.

* Realistic facial geometry, textures and skin appearance.

* Correcting inaccurate or distorted AI-generated faces.



This is our number one requirement.



2. CHARACTER RIGGING & FACIAL EXPRESSIONS — ESSENTIAL



You must understand how to prepare realistic human characters for animation.



This includes:



* Full-body skeletal rigging.

* Facial rigging, blendshapes and expression controls.

* Weight painting and deformation correction.

* Reusable rigs and animation compatibility across multiple characters.



3. NATURAL HUMAN CHARACTER ANIMATION — HIGH PRIORITY



You should have experience creating or refining realistic character movements.



Examples include:



* Natural hand gestures and body movements.

* Winks, smiles and facial expressions.

* Encouraging gestures, fist bumps and celebrations.

* Smooth animation transitions and reusable movement sequences.



4. REALISTIC TEXTURING & CHARACTER REFINEMENT — HIGH PRIORITY



Experience with:



* Realistic skin, eyes, eyebrows and hair.

* Facial textures and PBR materials.

* Human anatomy and full-body character construction.

* Correcting mesh geometry and visual defects.



5. RELEVANT 3D SOFTWARE & AI WORKFLOWS — ADVANTAGEOUS



Experience with any of the following would be beneficial:



* Blender

* Character Creator / Headshot

* iClone

* Autodesk Maya

* ZBrush

* Substance Painter

* Meshy AI, TRELLIS, Tripo or similar image-to-3D tools



Experience preparing characters for automated production pipelines, including FBX or GLB/glTF export, is an additional advantage.



6. UI/UX DESIGN, FIGMA & SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT — EXTREMELY ADVANTAGEOUS



Candidates who combine specialist 3D character-production experience with UI/UX design or software development capabilities will be particularly attractive to us.



We are developing an interactive application, so skills that help connect realistic 3D characters with the user interface and underlying software would provide significant additional value.



We would be especially interested in experience with:



UI/UX Design



* Figma and interactive prototyping.

* Mobile and web application interface design.

* User journeys, wireframes and design systems.

* Integrating animated characters into modern application interfaces.

* Creating polished, professional user experiences.



Front-End Development



* React, Next.js, JavaScript or TypeScript.

* HTML and CSS.

* Three.js, React Three Fiber or WebGL.

* Interactive 3D character integration within web applications.

* Responsive design and mobile performance optimisation.



Back-End Development & Automation



* Python, Node.js or similar technologies.

* API integrations and webhook workflows.

* Blender Python scripting and automated asset processing.

* AI model and 3D-generation API integrations.

* Automated character processing, validation and export.

* Cloud processing, task queues and asset-management systems.



Experience in any of these additional disciplines would be a major advantage and could create opportunities for broader responsibilities within the project.



However, these skills are supplementary. They do not replace the essential requirement for demonstrated realistic 3D human-character production, facial likeness and rigging expertise.



⸻



ABOUT THE APPLICATION



PNTZE is an interactive, creator-led education platform.



The application allows educators, instructors and content creators to appear as realistic, animated 3D versions of themselves.



These digital characters will guide users through structured learning experiences, interact with their progress and provide supportive gestures and facial expressions throughout the application.



For example, a makeup educator could have a realistic animated version of herself appearing within her own branded learning application.



YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITY



We need a specialist who can help establish a repeatable photo-to-3D character production workflow.



The process involves:



Real Creator Photograph → Accurate 3D Facial Likeness → Full-Body Character → Rigging & Facial Expressions → Natural Animation → Application-Ready Character



You will work alongside our existing developer, who is responsible for the software, application architecture and automation.



Your primary responsibility is the specialist 3D character-production work, particularly the areas requiring artistic judgement, anatomical accuracy, rigging expertise and animation refinement.



If you also have UI/UX, front-end or back-end development experience, you may have the opportunity to contribute more broadly to the application’s design, character integration and technical production pipeline.



Our objective is to produce high-quality characters that can eventually be created through a largely standardised and partially automated process.



⸻



WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY



Please do not apply if your experience is limited to:



* Basic Blender familiarity without realistic human-character projects.

* General 3D product, architectural or environment modelling.

* 2D illustration, graphic design or motion graphics only.

* AI-generated 3D images without practical mesh editing and character-production experience.

* Animation work without relevant character rigging or realistic human-character experience.

* UI/UX design, Figma, front-end or back-end development without the essential 3D character-production experience.



If you cannot demonstrate realistic 3D human-character work and meaningful experience with character rigging or animation, this position is unlikely to be suitable for you.



We value specialist, hands-on production experience over long software lists or general creative portfolios.



APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS



To be considered, please provide:



1. Realistic 3D human-character examples, preferably created from actual photographs.

2. Before-and-after facial likeness examples, showing the original person and completed 3D character.

3. Rigging and animation examples, demonstrating facial expressions and full-body movement.

4. A brief explanation of which parts of the modelling, rigging and animation process you personally completed.

5. Any additional UI/UX, Figma, front-end or back-end development experience, including examples of applications, interfaces or interactive 3D projects you have personally built.



Applicants who provide clear evidence of the essential 3D production skills will be prioritised for a technical discussion.



Our ideal candidate is a specialist who can produce realistic, recognisable, fully rigged and naturally animated human characters, with the additional ability to contribute to application design, interactive 3D integration or software development.



We are particularly interested in multidisciplinary specialists who can bridge the gap between high-quality 3D character production and the technical implementation of those characters within a live application.

This role combines proactive outbound sales, customer relationship management, and operational coordination. The ISA will work closely with the Dispatch and Operations teams to identify sales opportunities, secure profitable orders, and maximize fleet utilization.

Full-Time Dispatcher (Remote)

About the Role



Eveready Express is seeking a highly motivated, detail-oriented, and experienced Dispatcher to join our growing logistics team.



The ideal candidate must have at least two (2) years of experience working in the U.S. logistics or transportation industry and possess strong dispatching, route planning, and load coordination skills. You should thrive in a fast-paced environment, be able to effectively multitask, possess intermediate English communication skills, demonstrate expert computer skills, and have a growth mindset with a willingness to continuously learn and improve.



As a Dispatcher, you will be responsible for coordinating daily transportation operations, negotiating rates, assigning drivers, monitoring shipments, communicating with customers, and ensuring deliveries are completed safely, efficiently, and on time while maintaining compliance with DOT and ELD regulations.



Vehicles Being Dispatched

26-Foot Box Trucks (10,000 lb. weight capacity) – Dock-high with lift gate

Sprinter Vans

Cargo Vans

Ram ProMaster (High Roof)

About Eveready Express



Founded in 1984, Eveready Express is a trusted leader in trucking, courier, logistics, and distribution services. We proudly serve businesses throughout the Northeast by providing dependable transportation solutions backed by honesty, integrity, urgency, teamwork, and exceptional customer service.



Key Responsibilities

Dispatch Operations

Dispatch vehicles based on customer orders, schedules, and driver availability.

Negotiate rates with drivers while maintaining a target minimum 40% gross margin.

Assign loads efficiently to maximize profitability and operational performance.

Coordinate pickups and deliveries to ensure customer service expectations are met.

Driver Communication

Maintain continuous communication with drivers throughout their routes.

Provide dispatch instructions, updates, route changes, and operational support.

Ensure drivers follow company procedures and customer requirements.

Routing & Scheduling

Plan efficient delivery routes to minimize transit time, fuel consumption, and operating costs.

Adjust schedules quickly as operational needs or unforeseen circumstances arise.

Balance driver availability with customer delivery requirements.

Shipment Tracking

Monitor shipments in real time using GPS and dispatch software.

Proactively identify delays and coordinate solutions to minimize service disruptions.

Provide timely shipment updates to customers and internal teams.

Customer Service

Serve as the primary point of contact for customers after dispatch.

Respond professionally to customer inquiries.

Resolve delivery concerns while maintaining exceptional customer service.

Documentation & Compliance

Maintain accurate dispatch records, driver logs, shipment notes, Bills of Lading (BOLs), and Proofs of Delivery (PODs).

Ensure compliance with DOT regulations, ELD requirements, Hours of Service (HOS), company policies, and customer-specific procedures.

Problem Solving

Resolve logistical challenges including traffic delays, vehicle breakdowns, weather disruptions, missed appointments, and last-minute schedule changes.

Safety & Regulatory Compliance

Verify driver qualifications, vehicle readiness, insurance, and compliance with company safety standards.

Work closely with HR and Operations to ensure all regulatory requirements are met.

Team Collaboration

Collaborate with Customer Service, Operations, Billing, Sales, HR, Warehouse, and Drivers to ensure seamless daily operations.

Senior E-commerce Project Manager & Team Lead (Philippines)



Salary: USD 10.35 to 12.65 per hour, depending on experience (about USD 1,790 to 2,190 per month, full-time)

Hours: PH 13:00 to 22:00 (NL 07:00 to 16:00), Monday to Friday. An afternoon and evening shift, not a graveyard shift.

Type: full-time, remote, long term



HOW TO APPLY: you MUST apply through our application form. Applications without the form are not considered.

Form: type this in your browser without the spaces: docs . google . com / forms / d / e / 1FAIpQLScVXjNKzSil3UMyz4HtA9Mu2_YQVvAPN_Xe8SHpv5s7JPr7Fg / viewform

The form asks for a code word. You find it at the bottom of this post.



ABOUT VIBRIX

Vibrix is a Dutch brand for a healthy indoor climate. Our founder, Remco Lunshof, suffered from allergies and asthma for years. He tested air purifiers from the big brands, was not convinced, and in 2019 started Vibrix in Rijswijk (Netherlands) with one air purifier of his own. Johnny Ma joined as co-owner in 2023 and leads product development.



Today we sell air purifiers (PureFlow), dehumidifiers (DryFlow) and replacement filters to thousands of households through our own webshop, Bol and Amazon. We test every model ourselves before it goes on sale, customers get an answer from a real person every day, and we are rated 4.6 out of 5 on Trustpilot from more than 3,200 reviews. Our products are made by partner factories in China, and we now receive full 40HQ containers every month.



Our mission: healthy air in every home, in every season. We want to grow from the Netherlands and Belgium to more European countries, and over the next 12 to 18 months we are building a team of experienced people, most of them in the Philippines.



You will work directly with the owners, Remco and Johnny, and with Melvin (People & Talent).



THE ROLE

You are the first lead of our Philippine team and the project manager of our operation. You are responsible for the whole team.



We are hiring three senior roles at the same time: you, a Senior Supply Chain & Demand Planner and a Senior Amazon Marketplace Manager. You are involved in hiring from the start: you help select the candidates and join the interviews.



In your first 90 days you will:

• Own our project board: every task has one owner and a deadline, and you follow up until it is done.

• Follow up with every team member: work done on time and done well, feedback, and step in when something gets stuck.

• Help select the next hires: review applications, join interviews, give your advice.

• Set up a weekly rhythm for the team: one scorecard per role, one weekly call, a daily end-of-day update.

• Write down how the work is done (SOPs), so every new hire can start without someone sitting next to them.

• Take over day-to-day operational work from the owners, so they can focus on product and market.



After a year, success looks like this:

• Every role has a weekly scorecard and the team runs on it.

• Every process and every outside agency has one clear owner.

• No more than 2 issues per week end up with the owners.



WHAT WE ASK

• At least 3 years of proven experience in this role, at one or more comparable companies of the same size or bigger.

• At least 3 years of experience in e-commerce.

• At least 3 years leading a team of 5 or more people.

• You have hired at least 5 people yourself: you ran the selection and made or shared the final decision.

• In-house or agency experience, not only freelance or task-based work.

• This is your only job.

• Certificate of Employment from your last two employers. We check your years of experience with it.

• At least 15 Mbps download speed, measured on the computer and at the place you will work from. The form asks for the link to your speedtest.net result.

• A laptop with 8 GB RAM and a good headset.



Nice to have: experience with Monday, Asana or ClickUp.



We are looking for someone who knows more than we do about building and running a team. You learn fast, figure things out yourself and want to grow with the company.



WHAT THIS JOB IS NOT

• Not a VA or task-based role.

• Not a manager who only delegates. In the first months you do a large part of the work yourself.

• Not a graveyard shift.

Property Management Administrator

Position Overview



The Property Management Administrators (PMA) support the property management team by handling essential administrative tasks and ensuring the smooth operation of property management activities.  



  



Responsibilities



Communication: Assist in responding to owner and tenant inquiries and inform the PML of any escalated situations.  

Onboarding New Accounts: Enter property management agreement information into the property database and ensure all required documents are accurate.  

Marketing: Prepare property pages for advertising, post ads, update internal lists, and audit ads weekly. Follow up with inquiries, showings and applicants daily. 

Applications: Monitor applications, conduct initial tenant prescreening, run screening reports, and notify the PM of recommendations.

Delinquencies and Lease Violations: Help prepare notices for late payments and lease violations.  

Evictions: Assist in preparing court documents and tracking court dates.  

Insurance Tracking: Run insurance reports, notify owners of expired policies, and ensure compliance with standards.  

Move-Outs: Process notices to vacate, track move-outs, and assist with necessary repairs.  

Add/Remove Tenant Requests: Draft and execute required paperwork.  

Departing Owner: Assist in preparing terminating management packets.  

Forms and Checklists: Notify the Systems Manager of outdated forms and assist in maintaining checklists.  

Accounting: Add one-time charges to tenant ledgers as directed.  

Additional Duties: Support the team, maintain files and records, and perform all required tasks of a property manager.

You will work directly with the owners, Remco and Johnny, and with our new Team Lead.



THE ROLE

You own the question: how much do we need to buy, and when? You build the forecast, plan the purchase orders and make sure our best-selling products stay in stock.



Your first goal is a demand forecast per SKU that we can trust and run every month.



After a year, success looks like this:

• The forecast per SKU is within 25% of actual sales, 3 months ahead (MAPE).

• Our top 10 SKUs are out of stock on less than 5% of days.

• The purchasing rhythm with our suppliers in China runs without the owner stepping in.



WHAT WE ASK

• At least 3 years of proven experience in this role, at one or more comparable companies of the same size or bigger.

• At least 3 years of experience in supply chain or demand planning, for e-commerce or consumer products.

• In-house or agency experience, not only freelance or task-based work.

Nice to have: experience placing purchase orders with suppliers in China.



We are looking for someone who knows more than we do about forecasting and inventory. You learn fast, figure things out yourself and want to grow with the company.



WHAT THIS JOB IS NOT

• Not a data entry or admin role.

• Not a role where someone else builds the model and you update it.

title: Trailer Management Admin
description:
GH Logistics (AJG Transport) is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, and clear communication. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup to delivery.



If you’re someone who enjoys structured execution, asset visibility, and maintaining operational accuracy behind the scenes, you’ll feel right at home here.



Role Overview

You support the Trailer Manager in overseeing a fleet of 1000+ trailers across multiple carriers and terminals. You play a critical role in ensuring every trailer is accounted for, properly assigned, compliant, and operational. This is not a passive data-entry role. You’re the person who keeps the fleet picture accurate, coordinates trailer repair concerns, and flags problems before they cost us time and money.



You should be familiar with common trailer repair and maintenance issues and understand how to coordinate practical solutions with drivers, terminals, vendors, and maintenance teams. If you thrive on structure, take pride in clean records, and don’t let things slip through the cracks, this role was built for you.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor, update, and reconcile trailer locations across the network on a daily basis

• Coordinate with route supervisors, internal team, dispatchers, carriers, drivers, and terminals to ensure accurate trailer assignments and timely movement

• Track trailer availability, maintenance schedules, and repair status

• Identify trailer issues, assess their operational impact, and coordinate the appropriate repair solution

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date trailer documentation (registrations, inspections, tags, insurance)

• Support reporting on trailer utilization, downtime, and compliance

• Identify discrepancies, missing updates, or unreported trailer statuses and escalate promptly

• Assist in improving internal trailer tracking systems for better visibility and accuracy

• Execute processes consistently with strong attention to detail

• Collaborate cross-functionally with dispatch, compliance, and maintenance teams



What Success Looks Like

• Trailer locations and statuses are consistently accurate and fully reconciled

• Assignments, availability, and movements are properly documented and updated in real time

• Maintenance, repair, and compliance records are complete and up to date

• Trailer defects and repair needs are identified early, properly communicated, and resolved efficiently

• Discrepancies are identified early and resolved before impacting operations

• Reporting on utilization and downtime is clean, accurate, and actionable

• Communication across departments is clear, timely, and structured



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in fleet management, trailer maintenance coordination, logistics coordination, truck or trailer repairs, dispatch, or similar live operational roles (not general admin work)

• Familiarity with common dry van and refrigerated trailer repairs, defects, and maintenance concerns

• Ability to understand trailer repair issues, determine the appropriate next steps, and coordinate solutions

• Knowledge of common trailer components and issues, such as tires, brakes, lights, doors, landing gear, air lines, electrical systems, refrigeration units, and structural damage, is strongly preferred

• Strong attention to detail with high accuracy in tracking and record-keeping

• Organized and capable of managing multiple data points across systems and teams

• Clear and professional communication skills across departments

• Familiarity with platforms such as Samsara, LoadStop, or similar tracking systems is a plus

• Proactive mindset, able to identify and address issues before they escalate

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Logistics tools

• Reliable internet connection and fully equipped remote work setup

• Team oriented, coachable, and aligned with structured processes



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full time permanent remote role

• Direct Hire to a US Company (not agency or BPO)

• Current needed shifts: Thursday - Monday 11 PM - 9 AM CST | Thursday - Monday 8 PM - 6 AM CST | Tuesday - Saturday 8 PM - 6 AM CST

• Reliable home office setup and back up internet and power stations

• Zoom presence required (camera on throughout shift)

• Hubstaff time tracking during shifts.



What You'll Get

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Paid biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

• Stable & long-term position. This is not project-based nor seasonal. We're building a team and we need people who want to build with us.

• Direct access to US executive leadership. You're not buried in a call center reporting to a middle manager. You work directly with our operations team.

• Real operations work.



Who Thrives Here

• People who've worked in a US freight brokerage or 3PL and want something more stable

• Former fleet coordinators, logistics admins, or dispatch support staff who are tired of BPO environments

• Fleet admins who take ownership. You don't clock in and zone out. You manage trailers like they are your business.

• People who can recognize trailer issues, coordinate repairs, follow up consistently, and ensure equipment returns to service as quickly as possible

• People who want to grow into leadership but need the right company to do it in.



Who This Isn't For

• General VAs looking for easy remote work. This is real logistics and not admin tasks.

• People who need constant supervision or step by step instructions for every task

• Anyone who can't commit to US shift hours consistently

• Candidates without actual freight/logistics experience. We don't have time to teach the basics.

• Candidates who are unfamiliar with trailer maintenance concerns or are uncomfortable coordinating repairs and operational solutions



This role is built for someone who takes pride in maintaining control over moving assets, ensuring trailers are accounted for, properly assigned, properly repaired, and always operational. If you value structure, accuracy, problem-solving, and keeping operations running clean behind the scenes, you’ll thrive in this role.

title: Hiring a Full-Stack Software Engineer / Vibe Coder with Hands-On Android & iOS Experience
description:
**Hiring a Full-Stack Software Engineer / Vibe Coder with Hands-On Android & iOS Experience**  

**$3–$4 USD per hour | Long-term position**  

**All work is performed through a remote connection to our PC.**



We’re looking for a software engineer who uses **AI-assisted development and vibe coding** and has **hands-on experience developing Android and iOS applications**. You must be able to understand, review, debug, and test AI-generated code and take responsibility for completing working features.



The project is an automotive diagnostic tool with mobile apps, Windows desktop software, and a backend. We’re looking for someone reliable for ongoing development, integration, testing, and updates.



We already have the diagnostic algorithms, relevant source code, and working reference tools. You’ll adapt the existing code, integrate it with our hardware and applications, and verify the results against the reference tools.



**What you’ll work on**



- **Android and iOS apps.** Build the application interfaces, connect to our device through Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), run diagnostic functions, display results, and save encrypted backups locally and on the server.

- **Windows desktop software.** Communicate with the device through USB-C, run diagnostics, manage backups, and install secure firmware updates.

- **Backend and admin dashboard.** Develop APIs, databases, user accounts, device registration by serial number, and encrypted server backups. Provide administrative controls for managing users, linked devices, and device access.

- **Device firmware integration.** Work with the supplied code and algorithms to support reading vehicle identification numbers (VINs), EEPROM data, and diagnostic trouble codes.



**Required experience**



- Previous **Android and iOS app projects** you can demonstrate, including your role in implementation and testing.

- Using AI coding tools to develop features and troubleshoot issues.

- Testing applications on devices, diagnosing failures, and fixing bugs.

- Implementing BLE communication between mobile apps and hardware.

- Developing Windows applications that communicate with USB devices.

- Working with APIs, authentication, databases, and existing codebases.



**Bonus skills and willingness to learn**



Experience with CAN bus, OBD-II, UDS, DoIP, secure boot, signed firmware updates, hardware-protected keys, or encrypted storage is a plus. You should be willing to learn unfamiliar parts of the project and carry out firmware integration and testing with our hardware and reference tools.



**How to apply**



Please include all of the following in your application.



- Examples of **Android and iOS applications you have personally worked on**, with links, screenshots, or demos where available.

- What you personally implemented and how you tested it.

- Which AI coding tools you use and how you check the code they generate.

- Your weekly availability and hourly rate within the **$3–$4 USD** range.

- **Confirmation that you agree to work through a remote connection to our PC and are available for a long-term position.**

title: Customer Care Phone Specialist for a UK Premium Home Fragrance Brand (Near Native English Accent)
description:
Job type: Full time, long term

Hours: 40 hours a week, 6 days, UK time (see below)

Salary: $600 to $800 per month depending on experience and voice, reviewed after 30 days, plus our monthly team bonus whenever we hit our revenue target



ABOUT US



We are a UK premium home fragrance brand (waterless diffusers and fragrance oils) doing over £1M a year, run by the 2 founders. Most of our customers are UK adults, many of them older, and they buy from us because it feels personal.



READ THIS FIRST: YOUR VOICE IS THE JOB



This role is mostly phone calls with UK customers. You must speak English with a clear American or British accent, or very close to it. Our customers need to understand you the first time, without asking you to repeat yourself. If your accent is strong, this role is not for you, even if your written English is excellent. We will judge your voice recording before we read your CV.



WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS



Our Customer Service Manager is building the systems behind our support: reporting, product breakdowns, and fixing the causes of problems so fewer customers need to call. You take the front line so she can do that work. She will train you and manage you day to day.



WHAT YOU DO EVERY DAY



• Answer our customer phone line and live chat, warmly and calmly, including the occasional upset caller

• Give customers a live order and tracking update by checking Shopify and ShipStation (view only)

• Log every call in Gorgias, our helpdesk, as a properly tagged ticket so nothing gets lost

• Send our standard requests: a short video for a diffuser fault, photos for a missing or damaged item

• Chase open cases by phone and WhatsApp so no customer is left waiting without an update

• Make short aftercare calls to new customers: did it arrive, is it set up, any questions

• Reply to customer reviews

• Post your numbers in Slack at the end of each shift: calls answered, voi
s cleared, cases chased, reviews answered



WHAT YOU DO NOT DO



Refunds, replacements, carrier claims, chargebacks and escalated complaints all go to our CS Manager. You never promise anything you can't deliver. You take the details, set the right expectation and pass it on properly.



HOURS (UK TIME)



• Monday to Thursday: 9am to 5pm, with a 30 minute lunch from 1pm to 1:30pm

• Saturday and Sunday: 10am to 3pm

• Friday off



Right now, while the UK is on GMT, that is 5pm to 1am (weekdays) and 6pm to 11pm (weekends) Philippine time. From 28 March, when the UK clocks go forward, it moves 1 hour earlier.



WHO WE WANT



• A near native English accent (American or British) and a warm, confident phone manner

• At least 1 year of customer phone experience, ideally with UK or US customers

• Calm with upset people. You stay friendly, don't take it personally and don't overpromise

• Organised: every call gets logged, every follow up gets done

• A quiet place to work, a reliable internet connection with backup, and a good headset

• Experience with Gorgias, Zendesk, Shopify or similar is a plus, not a must



HOW TO APPLY



1. Write KESTREL as the first word of your application. Applications without it will not be read.

2. Record a voice note of 60 to 90 seconds (Vocaroo or Google Drive, set to "anyone with the link") and paste the link in your application. In it: answer the phone as if a customer has just called ("Good afternoon, you're speaking to [your name], how can I help?"). The customer says: "I ordered a diffuser 5 days ago and it still hasn't arrived. Where is it?" Reply exactly as you would on the call. Finish with 20 seconds about yourself.

3. In 3 to 5 sentences, tell us about a time a caller was upset with you and what you did.

4. Attach your CV.



We listen to every voice note first. If your voice isn't right for the role, we won't move on to your CV, so please make the recording in a quiet room.

title: Full Cycle Accountant
description:
About CAG Pros

CAG Pros is an accounting and tax firm. We keep the books and file the returns for small businesses, including state-licensed cannabis operators such as dispensaries, cultivators and distributors. We are a small remote team, so every person owns their work from start to finish.



Please apply only through the application form; candidates who contact CAG Pros directly about this role will be immediately disqualified.



About the role

We need an accountant who can own a set of client books from the first transaction to the final financial statements. You will handle the full accounting cycle for your clients each month, keep their filings on schedule, and keep the team updated on where everything stands.



This is not a data entry role. You will be the person who knows whether a client's books are right, what is due next, and what is missing. If you can also prepare tax returns, that is a strong plus, and there is tax work here for you.



What you'll do

Monthly bookkeeping and close

• Record and categorize transactions for each assigned client

• Reconcile bank, credit card, loan and merchant accounts every month

• Manage accounts payable: enter bills, track due dates, reconcile vendor balances

• Manage accounts receivable: record payments, follow up on open balances, reconcile customer accounts

• Post journal entries for accruals, prepaids, depreciation, payroll and adjustments

• Reconcile month-end inventory counts to the books and calculate cost of goods sold

• Close each client's books on a set schedule and review the general ledger for errors before you call it done



Reporting

• Prepare the monthly profit and loss, balance sheet and cash flow statement for each client

• Flag anything unusual, such as large swings, negative balances or uncategorized activity, with a short note explaining it

• Pull year-end workpapers and schedules so tax prep starts with clean books



Filings and compliance

• Prepare and file sales tax returns (monthly or quarterly, by state)

• Support payroll filings, W-2s and 1099s

• Track each client's filing deadlines and make sure nothing is filed late

• Apply cannabis-specific rules where they apply, including 280E and inventory costing



Tracking and communication

• Keep every client task current in ClickUp: what is done, what is in progress, what is waiting on the client

• Keep a clear schedule of what is due weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly for each client

• Request missing documents from clients and follow up until you have them

• Join team calls ready to give a status on each of your clients

• Write down how each client's books are done so someone else could step in if needed



Tax work (a plus, not required)

If you have tax experience, you will also:

• Prepare individual returns (Form 1040) and business returns (Forms 1120, 1120-S and 1065)

• Prepare nonprofit returns (Form 990) when needed

• Calculate quarterly estimated tax payments

• Prepare returns for internal review, then manage the signature (Form 8879) and e-file steps

• Respond to IRS and state notices

• Help clients with year-end planning, including 280E for cannabis operators



What you need

• [3+] years of full cycle accounting experience, handling books from transactions through financial statements

• Experience managing several client books at once at an accounting or bookkeeping firm

• Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks Online

• Working knowledge of ClickUp. You must already know how to use it to manage tasks and deadlines.

• Solid understanding of US GAAP, accrual accounting and month-end close

• Experience with inventory and cost of goods sold

• Experience filing US sales tax returns

• A habit of updating your tasks without being asked. The team should never have to chase you for a status.

• Clear written English and comfort talking with clients

• Reliable internet and availability for scheduled team calls



Nice to have

• US tax preparation experience (1040, 1120, 1120-S, 1065)

• Nonprofit tax return experience (Form 990)

• An active PTIN, or an EA or CPA license

• Experience with cannabis clients, 280E or other regulated, cash-heavy businesses

• Multi-state sales tax experience



Tools we use

• QuickBooks Online for client books

• ClickUp for tasks, deadlines and team chat

• Stanford Tax for tax return preparation

• Google Drive for documents

• Zoom for team and client calls



How we work

• You own your clients' books. If something is late or wrong, you raise it before anyone has to ask.

• Every client has a schedule, and ClickUp shows where each one stands.

• We meet as a team on a regular schedule to review client statuses.

• Questions go in ClickUp so answers are in one place.



Your first 90 days

• First 30 days: Learn each assigned client, take over their books from the current accountant, and confirm every deadline for the next quarter.

• By 60 days: Close every assigned client on schedule, with ClickUp fully current.

• By 90 days: Have the process for each client written down, and take on tax work if that is part of your role.



How to apply

1. We will review your
 entry.

2. A link to a application which includes the uploading of 2 to 3 minute intro video about your accounting background and how you keep client work tracked

3. Official virtual interview



Shortlisted candidates will complete a short paid skills test, then a video interview with the Accounting Manager and Operations Manager.

title: UK Accountant – Balance Sheet Review & Reconciliations (Xero)
description:
We're a London business group: Number 90, a bar, nightclub and events venue in Hackney Wick, and Mainyard Studios, a workspace business with 600+ residents. Mainyard runs each building as its own small company, and most of them are simple: rent in, costs out.



An external firm does most of our bookkeeping and set up our books, and a UK accountant reviews our accounts at year-end. That isn't changing. In-house, Erica handles our finance and credit control. She has grown with the business from building manager to running our numbers day to day.



We're looking for an accountant to join Erica. Your job is to catch problems before they reach our year-end accountant: balance sheet accounts that don't reconcile, payroll and tax payments posted to the wrong place, depreciation not posted, intercompany balances that don't agree. That frees Erica to focus on bigger things, such as negotiating deals.



If you can look at a balance sheet and tell us what's wrong with it, this role is for you.



What you'll do

• Review our companies' balance sheets every month and make sure every line ties to evidence: bank, PAYE, NIC, pensions, VAT, corporation tax, intercompany, loans and deposits

• Check the journals our bookkeeper and accountants post, and get the errors fixed

• Keep Xero up to date with our finance lead at Mainyard Studios: bank reconciliations, invoicing, chasing late payments and checking supplier bills

• Reconcile club nights at Number 90: promoter recharges, tech and PRS costs, supplier overcharges

• Build simple month-end checklists and help with budgets

There's plenty of hands-on reconciliation work. We want it done by someone who understands the whole balance sheet, not just the bank feed.



You must have

• A degree in Accountancy. CPA or audit experience is strongly preferred.

• 3+ years of balance sheet reconciliations and month-end close, ideally across several companies

• Daily, practical Xero experience

• UK experience: you've worked on UK clients' books, or you know UK VAT and payroll (PAYE and NIC) well enough to show us on the call

• Clear written English, and the habit of raising problems without being asked

Nice to have: Xero Advisor certification, hospitality or property experience.



Working hours

Full-time, 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday. Flexible within the day, with at least 4 hours a day overlapping UK business hours.



Salary & benefits

• Base salary: $1,000 USD per month

• 13th-month pay, pro-rated in your first year

• 20 days' paid holiday a year, inclusive of Philippine public holidays

• Up to 5 paid sick days a year



After passing 3 months' probation:

• Company-funded health insurance

• A quarterly recovery bonus of up to 75% of a month's salary, for money you find and recover that we would otherwise have lost



How to apply

Please do not reply directly to this advert. Create a Google Drive folder titled Your Full Name + Your Superpower, and include:

1. A short video (2 minutes max). Who you are and why this role interests you. Mention your name and today's date. Not a spoken CV.

2. "The Mistake I Found" (10 lines max). A time you found an error someone else made in the accounts: what it was, how you found it, and what you changed so it didn't happen again. Your real experience, not a textbook answer.

3. Your CV, plus your Xero certificate if you have one.

4. Take your DISC profile using this disc and add it to the folder:  



Share the folder with 
 and
 us the link.



What happens next: shortlisted candidates have a video call where we share a real balance sheet on screen and ask what you'd question. There's no preparation needed. If you know balance sheets, you'll enjoy it.



We use TimeProof for all working hours. It's not there to spy on you. It shows us how long tasks really take, so we can improve our processes. Split your day however suits you, as long as you cover the UK overlap and you're focused on us while you're working. If you're not comfortable with TimeProof, please don't apply.



Finish your application
 with the words Numbers Don't Lie, so we know you've read the whole advert.

description:
You Already Know How to Run a Market Center. Come Run It Better.



Market Center Administrator (MCA / AMCA)

Keller Williams · 100% Remote · Full-Time, US Hours



You know what month-end really looks like. You’ve chased a missing DA at the last minute, balanced the books against a transmittal that wouldn’t tie, and explained Company Dollar to a Team Leader for the third time.

Spot problems before they become problems, and tell us how to fix the process

We only do Keller Williams. No switching between random clients. Every person on the team speaks KW.

Less grind, more thinking. We build our own automation tools that take repetitive MCA work off your plate.

A real career ladder. Our Relationship Managers started in the seat you’re applying for. MCA → Senior MCA → Relationship Manager.

Stability. Long-term Market Center clients. Our first team member just celebrated six years with us.

Fully remote. No commute, a fixed 8-hour US Eastern shift, and a team that has your back at month-end.



You’re a Great Fit If:

You have 1+ year as a KW MCA or AMCA (2+ years and multi-Market-Center experience is a big plus)

You’ve done remote US real estate accounting

You take ownership and don’t wait to be told
