title: AI Automation & Integration Specialist | Codex / Claude Workspace
description:
Villa Vision Builders is a web design and marketing agency serving vacation-rental owners. We are hiring an AI Automation & Integration Specialist to build and maintain practical automations for our operations and, where there is a clear client need, for client workflows.



This is a hands-on implementation role. We need someone who can understand a business process, build a dependable solution, test it, document it, and maintain it. AI tools should help you work faster, but you must be able to inspect and troubleshoot the systems you create.



What you will work on

• Connect website enquiry forms with our CRM and agreed follow-up workflows.

• Automate parts of client onboarding, including collecting photos, property details, and missing content.

• Prepare recurring reports from approved data sources.

• Build small scripts and integrations that reduce repetitive work.

• Connect WordPress,
, CRM, and other tools through supported APIs or webhooks.

• Monitor automations, document how they work, and handle failures safely.



Initial priorities will be set with you based on current business processes. The role does not combine general website design, paid advertising, and copywriting.



What we are looking for

• Examples of working automations that you personally built.

• Practical experience with APIs, webhooks, and workflow tools such as n8n, Make, or Zapier.

• Enough coding ability to understand, test, and repair AI-assisted code.

• Careful handling of credentials, customer information, and permissions.

• Clear written documentation and communication.

• Codex or Claude experience is useful. Owning a paid subscription is not required.



Please answer these questions in your application

1. Share two systems you personally built. What problem did each solve, and which parts did you implement?

2. How do you test an automation, monitor failures, and keep credentials or customer data safe?

3. What hourly or project rate do you charge, and what minimum engagement do you accept?



Please share existing examples. We do not require unpaid sample work. Any practical trial would be agreed and paid before work begins.

title: Paid Ads Specialist | Google Ads and Meta Ads | Travel or Hospitality
description:
Villa Vision Builders is a web design and marketing agency serving vacation-rental owners. We are hiring a Paid Ads Specialist to help us plan, run, and measure advertising work for our business and client projects.



The work may include campaigns that generate enquiries from vacation-rental owners for Villa Vision Builders, as well as campaigns that help a client attract potential guests and direct bookings. Please state clearly which type of campaign you have managed. Our application questions distinguish these two audiences so we can understand your experience accurately.



What you will work on

• Recommend and manage campaigns on your strongest platform, Google Ads or Meta Ads.

• Research audiences, search intent, and campaign opportunities.

• Set up and check conversion tracking before using results to make decisions.

• Manage budgets and explain how you adjust campaigns when results are weak.

• Coordinate creative requirements with our design and social media support.

• Recommend relevant landing-page improvements.

• Report spend, qualified enquiries, bookings, and measurement limits in plain English.

• Where a client uses a separate booking platform, explain how you would measure the journey and what cannot be attributed reliably.



What we are looking for

• Verifiable campaign examples with objectives, dates, approximate spend, results, and your exact contribution.

• Strong ability in at least one of Google Ads or Meta Ads. You do not need to claim equal expertise in both.

• Working knowledge of conversion tracking and attribution.

• Hospitality, travel, or vacation-rental experience is preferred.

• Honest reporting. Do not promise guaranteed bookings or results outside your control.

• Clear written communication and organized campaign management.



Please answer these questions in your application

1. Describe a campaign you personally managed. Include its objective, timeframe, approximate spend, measured results, and your responsibilities.

2. How did you verify conversions, and what would you do if customers completed a booking on a separate booking platform?

3. Which platform is your strongest, what hourly or project rate do you charge, and what minimum engagement do you accept?



Please share existing case studies or portfolio examples. We do not require unpaid sample work. Any practical trial would be agreed and paid before work begins.

title: SEO & Content Specialist | WordPress | Travel and Vacation Rentals
description:
Villa Vision Builders is a web design and marketing agency serving vacation-rental owners. We are hiring an SEO & Content Specialist to plan, create, publish, and improve useful content for travel and vacation-rental websites.



This is a content-led SEO role. We need someone who can explain why a page should exist, who it is for, and how it supports the website and its business goals. Our content should help potential guests make useful decisions and discover a property naturally. We do not want generic, keyword-stuffed, or lightly edited AI content.

• Write or edit destination guides, local-area content, and other relevant pages.

• Check facts and sources, especially for travel details that can change.

• Publish and format content in WordPress.

• Improve titles, headings, metadata, internal links, and relevant existing pages.

• Review Google Search Console data and recommend practical next steps.

• Use AI carefully for research support or early drafts, then fact-check and edit the final work.



What we are looking for

• Strong English writing and editing judgment.

• Evidence of keyword and topic research tied to real page plans.

• Live examples of travel, hospitality, or comparable content you worked on.

• WordPress publishing experience and sound on-page SEO skills.

• Familiarity with internal linking and Google Search Console.

• Careful fact-checking and the ability to distinguish measured results from assumptions.

• Technical development experience is useful but not required. Advanced development remains with our developer.

title: AI Avatar & Animated Ads Creator | Health E-commerce Brand
description:
Instead of starting with a list of requirements, here is what a normal week in this role looks like.



On Monday you receive a few scripts from our team. You build a realistic avatar from a photo in HeyGen, animate it, and produce the voiceover in ElevenLabs. By midweek you're in Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance) building a Pixar-style animated ad from scratch. In between, you're sourcing clips for a VSL, cutting a UGC-style ad from raw footage, and making five new hook variations of last week's winner. On Friday you look at the ad results with the team and d
 what to iterate on next.



If that sounds like a week you'd enjoy, read on.



WHO WE ARE

We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products for the health supplement niche. Paid social is one of our main growth channels, so video creative is not just "content" for us. It is one of the biggest drivers of the business. This is a full-time role, 40 hours per week, producing ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels.



YOUR REGULAR TASKS

- Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen

- Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts

- Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield

- Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs

- Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

- Editing with music, voiceover, sound effects, transitions, and subtitles

- Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

- Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

- Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios

- Uploading finished videos to Google Drive, clearly named and organized

- Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

- Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations



THE ADS YOU'LL BE MAKING

- AI avatar ads: realistic avatars created from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide

- Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)

-
 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos that grab attention quickly and drive purchases

- UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

- Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action

- Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

- VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure

- Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures



You'll usually start from a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes, and finish with a polished ad ready for testing. When there is no footage to work with, you generate it yourself with AI.



WHAT "GOOD" MEANS HERE

We believe a good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action. That is why we're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We're looking for someone who understands direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative. Your videos should:

- Stop people in the first 1 to 3 seconds

- Make the problem feel real and urgent

- Show the product clearly and persuasively

- Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

- Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

- Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

- Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

- Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase



None of this means ugly or low quality. It means every editing choice supports the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



WHAT YOU NEED

- HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation

- ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover

- Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video

- At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use



WHAT HELPS

- Meta/Facebook ad creatives

- Short-form paid social videos

- Long-form VSLs or sales videos

- Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

- Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools

- A bonus if you've worked in the health supplement niche



YOU'LL ENJOY THIS JOB IF YOU

- Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands

- Have hands-on experience producing creatives with AI tools, not just experimenting with them

- Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

- Can create multiple ad variations quickly

- Know how to follow references without copying them blindly

- Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

- Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

- Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

- Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good



WHAT YOU GET IN RETURN

- Competitive compensation based on experience

- The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue

- Clear creative direction and fast feedback

- Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively, for someone who wants more responsibility over time



We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we'd love to hear from you.

title: Operations Coordinator | UK Home Services Company |
description:
The Role



You will be responsible for coordinating our engineers, managing job progression, monitoring customer communications and ensuring that every appointment, repair and follow-up is handled efficiently.



You will work closely with our Bookings, Finance and Customer Experience teams.



Your primary responsibility is to ensure that jobs progress smoothly from booking through to completion, with clear ownership, accurate records and timely customer updates.



Key Responsibilities



1. Engineer Scheduling and Coordination



Coordinate daily engineer appointments and schedules.



Monitor engineer availability, travel and appointment commitments.



Ensure engineers have the correct job information before attending.



Communicate schedule changes and delays promptly.



Follow up with engineers regarding outstanding work.



Ensure return visits are arranged efficiently.



2. ServiceM8 Job Management

Maintain accurate job statuses in ServiceM8.



Ensure every job has a clear next action and responsible person.



Review jobs awaiting scheduling, parts and engineer follow-up.



Identify overdue jobs and take action to resolve delays.



Ensure completed jobs are correctly documented and progressed.

Confirm specifications and measurements before orders are placed.



Coordinate approved orders with suppliers.



Track delivery dates and outstanding orders.



Arrange return visits once parts become available.



Keep customers informed of delays and expected completion dates.



4. WhatsApp and Customer Communication

Ensure all new enquiries receive a meaningful initial response within five minutes during staffed hours.



Delegate new booking enquiries to the Bookings team.



Respond to operational questions regarding appointments, engineers, parts and return visits.



Follow up with customers waiting for updates.



Escalate complaints and sensitive issues to the appropriate team member.



5. Engineer Performance and Job Quality

Check that before and after photographs are uploaded.



Ensure engineers provide clear job completion notes.



Confirm outstanding works and parts requirements are recorded.



Identify incomplete jobs and arrange appropriate follow-up.



Escalate recurring workmanship or performance issues.



6. Department Coordination

Provide Caryna in Finance with complete job information for invoicing.



Coordinate with Kamiah on customer complaints and service follow-ups.



Support Margaret with operational information for new business opportunities.



Ensure every department knows what action is required and when.



7. Reporting and Accountability



Produce a concise daily operations report.



Identify jobs awaiting scheduling, parts or return visits.



Highlight customers requiring urgent attention.



Monitor overdue actions and unresolved issues.



Report engineer performance and operational bottlenecks.



Escalate only matters requiring management decisions.



What This Role Does Not Include



The Operations Coordinator will not be responsible for:

Bank reconciliation, payroll or financial reporting.



Approving unbudgeted expenditure.



Managing advertising or marketing campaigns.



Making major commercial decisions without authorisation.



Finance and invoicing remain the responsibility of Zippey's Finance Manager.



Skills and Experience



Essential



Excellent organisational and time management skills.



Strong written and spoken English.



Experience coordinating multiple tasks and people.



Confident handling customer communications.



Ability to work independently and take ownership.



Strong attention to detail.



Comfortable using digital scheduling and CRM systems.



Ability to remain calm under pressure.



Desirable



Experience with ServiceM8 or similar field service software.



Experience coordinating tradespeople or field engineers.



Knowledge of property maintenance, repairs or construction.



Experience using WhatsApp Business, Google Workspace and Slack.



Previous experience in operations coordination or service delivery.



The Person We Are Looking For



We want someone who:



Takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions.



Notices problems before they become customer complaints.



Communicates clearly and professionally.



Follows through until tasks are completed.



Is comfortable holding engineers and colleagues accountable.



Enjoys improving processes and removing inefficiencies.



Takes pride in providing exceptional customer service.



Can make sensible decisions without constant supervision.



Key Performance Indicators



Performance will be assessed against:



Job progression: Every active job has an accurate status, owner and next action.



Scheduling: Jobs ready for booking are actioned promptly.



Parts management: Outstanding parts have confirmed ownership, supplier status and next steps.



Customer communication: New enquiries receive a meaningful first response within five minutes during staffed hours.



Job documentation: Completed jobs have the required notes, photographs and completion details.



Return visits: Follow-up appointments are arranged promptly once work can proceed.



Operational efficiency: Fewer overdue jobs, avoidable delays and unnecessary management escalations.



What Success Looks Like



Within the first 30 days



You understand Zippey's operations, engineers and ServiceM8 processes. You have taken ownership of the daily scheduling, parts and follow-up queues.



Within 60 days



Every active job has a clear owner and next action. Engineer communication and customer updates are consistent, and outstanding jobs are actively managed.



Within 90 days



Daily operations run reliably without the Founder needing to chase routine appointments, engineers, parts or customer updates.



Why Join Zippey?



This is an opportunity to play an important role in building a growing, ambitious service business.



You will have genuine responsibility, the opportunity to improve how the company operates and the potential to grow into a senior operations management position as Zippey expands.

title: Executive Assistant to the Directors (Business Admin and Operations), Australian Brand Agency
description:
Soto Group is a brand strategy and creative agency based in Perth, Western Australia. We are looking for an exceptional Executive Assistant to support our two directors. You will pick up business admin, light operations and some marketing support, working directly with the Strategic Director day to day.



The role is not tightly defined and that is the point. We want someone who learns quickly, works things out for themselves, keeps good systems and is comfortable supporting busy people in a creative industry.



If you have supported founders, directors or senior managers before, enjoy variety and like being the person who notices what has been missed, we would like to hear from you.



ABOUT US

We help Australian businesses with brand strategy, rebrands, websites and marketing. We work with professional services firms, construction and trades, agriculture, not for profits and growing small to medium businesses. The agency has been running for over a decade and is led by two directors: a Strategic Director, who runs client strategy, sales and the business side, and a Creative Director, who runs web and creative delivery.



The core team is small and works remotely. You will work most closely with the Strategic Director, and alongside a Marketing Manager who is also based in the Philippines. Design and development are handled by a dedicated external studio, and we use a set of shared systems so that anyone can see what is happening on any project.



We are a busy, honest and direct team. We say what we think, we expect the same back, and we would rather you ask a question than guess. We also take constructive feedback well and expect to give it in return.



ROLE GUIDE

The role exists to take recurring admin, scheduling and operational chasing off the directors so they can spend their time on clients and strategy. In practice that means you own the small things that otherwise fall through the cracks, keep the directors organised, and help the Marketing Manager where you have capacity.



What you will do

Not every task will happen every week, and the mix will shift as you learn the business. This list shows the range so you know what you are signing up for.



Executive support (core, daily)

• Manage the Strategic Director's calendar: book and protect project time, client calls, resolve clashes; send agendas and reminders

• Triage the Strategic Director's inbox: flag what needs a reply, file the rest, draft replies for approval, chase outstanding items

• Prepare for meetings: pull together notes, links and documents; take notes on calls when asked; log actions afterwards

• Keep a running list of director commitments and follow ups, and nudge until they are done

• Book travel, events and logistics (conference stands, deliveries, suppliers)

• Handle personal admin for the directors occasionally and with discretion



Business admin (weekly)

• Maintain the "Access and accounts" register: tools, seats, costs, owners and renewal dates; cancel what is no longer used and flag renewals before they bill

• Keep the compliance calendar current: insurance, domain, ASIC and subscription renewals

• Set up and file contractor agreements and onboarding paperwork

• Keep the SOP library (Waybook) tidy: update steps as processes change, archive what is out of date

• Tidy and format documents, templates and presentations in Word, PowerPoint, Google Docs and Canva

• Light Xero support: raise invoices from the schedule with director approval, attach receipts and bills so the bookkeeper can reconcile



Light operations (daily and weekly)

• Check active client projects: flag overdue tasks, tasks with no owner and tasks with no due date

• Check the client portal daily for new client comments, approvals and overdue client tasks, and send the agreed nudges

• Check the design studio queue and confirm briefs are complete before they go out

• Run the onboarding checklist for every new project: folders, Teamwork setup from template, portal, agreement and scope of work issued, kickoff booked

• Run the offboarding checklist at project close: handover guide, logins confirmed, referral
 sent, review and case study tasks created

• Keep communication and decision logs current on the larger projects

• Prepare a short monthly operations summary for the directors: hours against budget by project, overdue tasks, retainer hours used



Marketing support

• Schedule approved social posts and newsletters in our scheduling tools

• Make basic Canva edits to templates and existing designs (resizing, swapping copy or images)

• Keep the content calendar and marketing task list current in Teamwork

• Light research: competitors, awards, directories, events, contact lists

• Proofread and format blog posts, case studies and reports before they go to the Marketing Manager

• Chase clients for testimonials, reviews and case study approvals



Client facing admin

• Acknowledge new enquiries on
 and log in HubSpot

• Send meeting confirmations, proposals and documents on behalf of the directors

• Follow up outstanding approvals, content and logins with clients by
 and portal (phone follow up only once you are settled and comfortable)



Who we are looking for

You must have:

• At least three years supporting a founder, director or senior manager, ideally in an agency, studio, consultancy or other professional services business

• Excellent written English. You will write to clients and suppliers on behalf of the directors, so clear, warm, correct English is not negotiable

• Experience running someone else's calendar and inbox, not just your own

• Hands on experience with at least one project management tool (Teamwork, Asana, ClickUp, Monday or similar) and comfort learning new systems from documentation and video

• Confident with Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 and Canva

• A track record of working out how to do something before asking, and asking clearly when you are stuck

• Reliable internet, a quiet workspace and the ability to work Australian Western Standard Time hours (the same as Philippine time)



It would help if you have:

• Worked for an Australian, UK or New Zealand business and understand the tone and expectations

• Used Xero, HubSpot, Slack, Loom or a client portal or proofing tool

• Supported a marketing team with scheduling, formatting or research

• Basic understanding of how a website or rebrand project runs



How you work:

• You notice things. The renewal nobody flagged, the task with no owner, the
 that needs a reply

• You keep good lists and close loops. You do not leave things half done

• You are direct and honest. If something is unclear or a deadline will slip, you say so early

• You like variety and can switch between admin, systems and creative support without losing track

• You are discreet with financial, client and personal information

• You want one varied role, over three part time ones

title: Creative Agency Operations Manager / Business Manager

title: Funnel Builder
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW



We are a home-renovation group in the Netherlands with a bathroom brand, a tile brand and a wider group of home-improvement brands. Our websites exist to generate leads: a showroom appointment, a free 3D bathroom design or a request for advice. Not an online sale.



JOB DESCRIPTION



This is not a web-development role. If you have built WordPress websites but have never measured a conversion rate and improved it, this is not the job for you. We are looking for someone who thinks in numbers first and builds second.



You turn website visitors into leads and showroom appointments. For each offer we run (an inspiration book, a free 3D design, a style quiz, a price calculator) you own the whole route: landing page, form, thank-you page and the step to an appointment. You d
 what to test, you build the variant yourself in our WordPress/Elementor setup, you measure every step and you report what the numbers say, including when they say nothing yet. The pages are in Dutch; the copy comes from our Dutch team, you own the structure, the build and the results. About a third of your time goes to our bathroom brand, which has a showroom with 70+ complete bathrooms; the rest goes to the lead funnels of the other brands in the group.



MAJOR FUNCTIONS



Start with a baseline: measure the routes we already have (appointment form, inspiration book, free 3D design): visitors, form starts, submissions, appointments. Every later change is compared with that.

D
 what to test and why: one hypothesis at a time, written down before you build. Big changes (offer, headline, form length, page structure) where traffic is low; A/B tests only where there is enough traffic to conclude anything.

Build the variant yourself: landing page, form, thank-you page and next step in WordPress with Elementor Pro and Gravity Forms. Mobile-first, fast, one goal per page.

Build forms that qualify: short on a phone, multi-step where it helps, conditional logic, a calculator where the offer needs one, and one or two questions that tell our sales team how serious the lead is.

Make sure every lead arrives: form entry to our CRM (Bitrix24) with its source (UTM), confirmation
 triggered, conversion counted in GA4 and Meta. You test the whole route yourself before and after every change.

Report monthly in numbers: visitors, leads, appointments, conversion rate per step, what you tested, what you concluded, what you test next. A test with no clear result is a valid result; a report without numbers is not.

Deliver landing pages for our ad campaigns and opt-in pages for our
 flows, matched to the ad or
 the visitor comes from, and turn what works into templates every brand can reuse.



REQUIRED SKILLS



2+ years of conversion work on lead-generation funnels, with before-and-after conversion rates you can show. A screenshot of analytics or form data is required with your application; pretty pages without numbers are not considered.

You have run real tests: you can describe the hypothesis, the change, the sample size, the duration and the conclusion. You know when a test has too little data and what you do instead.

You build your own variants in WordPress with Elementor Pro and a form builder (ideally Gravity Forms: multi-step, conditional logic, calculations, hidden fields, webhooks). Experience in ClickFunnels, GoHighLevel or 
 alone is not enough.

Landing-page structure: one goal per page, message match with the ad, a clear offer, proof, a form no longer than it needs to be.

Basic tracking you set up yourself: GA4 events, Google Tag Manager, thank-you-page or form-submit conversions, UTM parameters in hidden fields.

Careful on live pages: you submit every form route yourself, on mobile and desktop, and check that the lead reached the CRM.

Clear written English. You can explain a test result, including an inconclusive one, to a non-technical colleague in a few sentences.



TOOLS WE USE



Elementor Pro and a form builder are required to build the variants; experience with the rest is a plus. Tell us which ones you have worked with.



WordPress Multisite with Elementor Pro and Gravity Forms (MetForm on one current site).

GA4, Google Tag Manager and Looker Studio.

Microsoft Clarity or Hotjar for recordings and heatmaps; a split-testing plugin. Tell us what you use.

Bitrix24 (CRM) and 
 on the receiving end of the forms.

Meta Ads: pixel and conversion events on landing pages.



NICE TO HAVE



High-ticket local services (renovation, kitchens, solar, real estate) where a conversion is an appointment, not a purchase.

Calculators or quizzes built as lead magnets.

Appointment-booking tools and calendar integrations.

Working with copy in a language you don't speak.

EU privacy rules: consent on forms, cookie consent and what it does to your tracking.

Knowledge of Dutch or German.



AVAILABILITY



Part-time, about 12 hours per week, flexible. You meet with our Dutch colleagues during Amsterdam business hours (CET/CEST), which is afternoon and evening in the Philippines. When a campaign has a start date, the landing page is live and tested before that date. A reliable, high-speed internet connection is required.



EXPECTATIONS



You care about what happens after the click. A lead that never reaches our sales team is worth nothing, and ten serious leads are worth more than fifty weak ones. You d
 on numbers and you say so when there is too little data to d
, even when someone wants an answer. Nothing goes live in Dutch before a Dutch colleague has checked it.



WORKING CONDITIONS / SALARY



$239/month. Part-time now, with room to grow as more brands and offers go live. Long-term, stable role.



BONUSES



Paid Time Off after 1.5 months · salary reviews every 2–3 months · professional-development budget · second monitor after 6 months · new laptop after 2 years.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word “UPLIFT” so we know you have read the full post. Then answer these four questions, 3 to 6 sentences each:



Describe one lead-generation funnel where you improved the conversion rate: the offer, what the rate was before and after, over how many visitors, and the one change that made the biggest difference. Attach a screenshot of the analytics or form data that shows it (client names removed). Without numbers and a screenshot, we don't consider the application.

Two versions of a landing page ran at the same time. Version A: 420 visitors, 19 leads. Version B: 380 visitors, 24 leads. Is B the winner? What do you do next, and why?

A visitor requests our free bathroom inspiration book. A new bathroom is a purchase people think about for months. What do you build on the page, in the form and after the form so that the serious visitors end up with a showroom appointment, and how do you measure each step?

A form entry has to reach our CRM with its source, trigger a confirmation
 and count as a conversion in GA4 and Meta. How do you set that up, and how do you check afterwards that no lead has been lost?



Also include:



One link to a landing page or funnel you built yourself in WordPress with Elementor (a screenshot if it is no longer live), with one sentence on your part in it.

Which of the tools under “Tools we use” you have worked with, and which hours (Philippine time) you are available for meetings with our Dutch team.



We read every application that starts with the codeword, answers the questions specifically and includes the screenshot. Generic or copy-paste replies aren't considered.

title: Senior US Tax Accountant
description:
An Accounting Firm based in Chicago, USA seeking a highly experienced US Tax & Accounting professional with strong technical expertise in individual and business taxation. The ideal candidate should understand how accurate bookkeeping serves as the foundation for tax compliance, tax planning, and advisory services.



The role requires hands-on technical capabilities, independent problem-solving, and the ability to manage complex tax and accounting matters.



Key Responsibilities



1. Tax Preparation & Review



Prepare and review federal and state individual and business tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1065, 1120S, and 1120.

Handle tax returns at either the preparer or reviewer level, depending on the complexity of the return and the candidate's technical competency.

Identify tax issues, reporting inconsistencies, and opportunities for tax optimization.



2. Tax Planning & Advisory



Prepare individual and business tax projections and tax plans.

Analyze tax implications of business transactions and financial decisions.

Provide practical, tax-efficient recommendations based on applicable federal and state tax laws.

3. Tax Notices & Issue Resolution



Research and resolve IRS and state tax notices.

Identify compliance issues, determine corrective actions, and coordinate necessary responses.

Handle tax amendments and other tax-related resolutions.

4. Client Communication & Advisory



Communicate directly with clients regarding tax returns, outstanding requirements, tax liabilities, and planning recommendations.

Explain complex tax matters in a clear and practical manner.

Address client questions and provide technical guidance.

5. Bookkeeping & Tax Alignment



Serve as a technical consultant to the bookkeeping team to ensure financial records are properly aligned with tax reporting requirements.

Review tax-sensitive accounting transactions, classifications, and year-end adjustments.

Identify and resolve discrepancies between financial statements and tax returns.



6. Tax & Regulatory Compliance



Handle other federal, state, and local tax compliance requirements.

Research applicable tax laws and regulatory changes.

Ensure timely and accurate compliance filings.



7. New Client Onboarding & Accounting Projects



Lead accounting-related onboarding projects, including bookkeeping cleanup, catch-up, and historical reconciliations.

Evaluate existing books, identify accounting deficiencies, and recommend corrective actions.

Establish tax-ready accounting records and appropriate financial reporting structures.



Candidate Profile



Strong technical competency in US individual and business taxation.

Solid understanding of US accounting principles and their relationship to tax reporting.

Proven ability to independently research and resolve complex tax issues.

Experience preparing tax plans and providing client advisory.

Hands-on experience in bookkeeping cleanup, financial reporting, and accounting reconciliations.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and client communication skills.

We have an SEO agency, but we're looking to replace them with a freelance web developer instead.

- Requesting indexing in Google Search Console for pages that need it

- Logging every job in ClickUp so we can report it to the client



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Fluent English + good communication skills

- Proven SEO experience (meta, linking, schema, canonicals, indexing, redirects etc)

- Solid WordPress experience (Elementor, Yoast or Rank Math, plugins, redirects)

- Squarespace experience (a big plus, a few of our clients are on it)

- Familiar with Google Search Console / Google Tag Manager / GA4

- Able to read a basic site audit

- Careful, detail-focused, and happy to follow a checklist exactly

- Reliable internet and a regular weekly schedule



NICE TO HAVE



- Hands-on experience using AI tools

- Basic HTML/CSS/JavaScript for tidy manual fixes

- Experience with Cloudflare, cPanel or WP Engine hosting

- Healthcare or local service business experience



HOW TO APPLY



Please include one or two links to SEO or web projects you've worked on.

description:
META ADS | AI VIDEO MAKER/EDITOR



We're looking for an AI video maker/editor who understands one thing clearly:

A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.

We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products for the health supplement niche, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.

We're looking for someone who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels.

This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



WHAT YOU'LL BE CREATING AND EDITING

You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:

AI avatar ads: realistic avatars created from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide





Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)





 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases





UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly





Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action





Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof





VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure





Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We're looking for someone who understands how ads work.

You should know how to make videos that:

Stop people in the first 1–3 seconds





Make the problem feel real and urgent





Show the product clearly and persuasively





Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention





Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok





Communicate benefits quickly and clearly





Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof





Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase





You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes… then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. And when there's no footage to work with, you should be able to generate it yourself with AI.

THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

You'll be a strong fit if you:

Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands





Have hands-on experience producing creatives with AI tools, not just experimenting with them





Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative





Can create multiple ad variations quickly





Know how to follow references without copying them blindly





Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow





Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused





Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast





Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good





We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

You need experience with:

HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation





ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover





Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video





At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use





 you also have experience with:

Meta/Facebook ad creatives





Short-form paid social videos





Long-form VSLs or sales videos





Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing





Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools





Bonus if you've worked with the health supplement niche.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY

Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen





Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts





Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield





Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs





Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references





Editing with music, voiceover, sound effects, transitions, and subtitles





Creating variations of winning ads for further testing





Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs





Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios





Uploading finished videos to Google Drive, clearly named and organized





Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance





Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations





WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

Competitive compensation based on experience





The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue





Clear creative direction and fast feedback





Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively.





We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for someone who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.

If you're an AI video maker/editor who understands performance creative, we'd love to hear from you.

Paid social is one of our main growth channels, so the person who makes our video ads has a direct effect on how fast the company grows. This is a full-time position, 40 hours per week, working on a single brand.



WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

- Competitive compensation based on experience

- Long-term growth with the brand, with more responsibility over time for someone who wants it

- Clear creative direction and fast feedback, so you are never guessing what we want

- Work that matters: your ads directly drive revenue, and you will see the results



THE ROLE

You'll be our AI video maker and editor, creating high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels. The role fits someone who understands direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



The kinds of video you'll work on:

- AI avatar ads: realistic avatars made from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide

- Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)

-
 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos made to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

- UGC-style creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

- Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits showing the product in action

- Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits that use reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

- VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure

- Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures



WHAT YOUR WORK WILL LOOK LIKE DAY TO DAY

- Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen

- Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts

- Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield

- Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs

- Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

- Editing with music, voiceover, sound effects, transitions, and subtitles

- Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

- Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

- Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios

- Uploading finished videos to Google Drive, clearly named and organized

- Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

- Using feedback from ad results to make each iteration stronger



WHAT YOU NEED TO BRING

- HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation

- ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover

- Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video

- At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use



It also helps if you have experience with:

- Meta/Facebook ad creatives

- Short-form paid social videos

- Long-form VSLs or sales videos

- Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

- Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools



Experience in the health supplement niche is a bonus.



HOW WE THINK ABOUT ADS

A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action. So we are not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We want videos that:

- Stop people in the first 1 to 3 seconds

- Make the problem feel real and urgent

- Show the product clearly and persuasively

- Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

- Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

- Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

- Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

- Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase



You'll take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes, then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. When there's no footage to work with, you'll generate it yourself with AI.



THE PERSON WHO STAYS AND GROWS WITH US

- Has experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands

- Has hands-on experience producing creatives with AI tools, beyond experimenting

- Understands direct-response marketing and paid social creative

- Creates multiple ad variations quickly

- Follows references without copying them blindly

- Has good instincts for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

- Makes simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

- Is comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

- Cares about whether the videos actually perform, not just whether they look good



Creative that sells is not ugly or low quality. It means every editing choice supports the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



We're building a serious e-commerce brand. If you want a stable, long-term role where your work is visible and valued, we'd love to hear from you.

title: AI Image Designer (ChatGPT, OpenArt + Canva) | Premium Spiritual Wellness Brand
description:
At Anima we sell spiritual tools that create a spark: crystal sets, incense and candles that open your eyes to what is already inside you. The products are a catalyst; the person is the creator. Every Anima piece is created with one intention: to raise the consciousness and vibration of the planet. We sell on Amazon in the US, Canada, the UK, across Europe and in Australia, our own store is launching, and we are a fast-growing e-commerce company that runs on AI. Image quality is the heart of the brand.



If you are interested in spirituality, meditation and crystals, and you care about this kind of product, you will fit here better than someone who only sees a picture to make.



THE JOB



You turn briefs into finished, on-brand images with AI. Our Creative Strategist gives you the product, the angle, the message, example copy and reference photos of the real product. You generate the image with AI (ChatGPT and OpenArt today), make the product in the picture exactly the product we ship, retouch and finish it in Canva, set the copy on it, and deliver files ready to publish.



Today most of the work is Amazon listing images and A+ content. Website, ads, social, packaging and new product lines come next, and they all need the same thing from you: a finished image with the right words on it. You do not d
 what gets made or write the brief. You own the craft.



Anima runs on AI systems. Our brand rules, product facts and procedures live in a company AI you are connected to from day one, and our AI agents help you get the wording and direction of each image right before you generate. The system gives you the what; you bring the how.



You are measured on three numbers we share with you every month: on-time delivery (you set the date, you hit it, target 95%), first-pass approval (approved with one round of notes or none, target 75% within your first 60 days), and output (finished files delivered).



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Experience making AI images that sell. The one thing we care about most. You have produced AI imagery for e-commerce or retail brands, for products that were actually sold, not AI art because it looks beautiful. You can show three pieces and explain exactly how you made each one.

- Product and model fidelity. We make images that do not look like AI images. The product must be exactly the product we ship (shape, colour, label, logo), and any person in the frame must look real. If you cannot get the product right, nothing else matters.

- An eye for every detail. AI leaves mistakes behind: misspelled text on a label, a logo out of shape, extra fingers, a placeholder left in a document. You find and fix them before anyone else sees the file.

- AI image tools and Canva, fast in both. Every image is retouched and finished by hand: fidelity, colour, cleanup, layout, type. Photoshop is fine for parts of it; Canva is where the team works.

- Excellent written English. Not good, excellent. You write the words that go on the picture, so a headline from you reads like a native copywriter wrote it. We read your application as your first English test.

- You hold a brand. Ten images from you look like one company made them.



WHO YOU ARE



Ambitious. You work hard and you go beyond what was asked. Optimistic and joyful to work with. Smart enough to understand feedback the first time and apply it the next, not argue it. You ask questions before you start, not after you deliver, and you find your own solutions.



Strong pluses: you already know Amazon's image rules (pure white main image, A+ modules for desktop and mobile). You have lived, studied or worked outside the Philippines, worked closely with Western brands and teams, or travelled widely. Our customers are in North America, Europe and Australia, and people with that exposure fit the team faster.



PAY AND SCHEDULE



- USD 1,500 to 2,000 per month depending on experience, paid monthly. Pay is reviewed twice a year against your KPIs; consistently hitting them earns bonuses tied to those KPIs.

- Full-time, Monday to Friday, 8 hours a day. Four hours are fixed, 4:00 pm to 8:00 pm Philippine time, alongside our team in Europe and Bangkok. You organise the other four.

- Full-time independent contractor, working only for Anima (no other clients). Start as soon as possible, three-month probation. We pay for the AI tools and Canva Pro you use for our work.

- You report to our Creative Strategist.



HOW WE HIRE



1. We read every complete application and invite the strongest to a paid test.

2. A paid test from a real brief (USD 50, whatever the outcome). It is the same work as the job, and it is how we choose. You tell us when you will deliver, and we see if you hit it.

3. One 45-minute video call in English with our CEO, CMO and Creative Strategist: your test, the role, pay and start date.



HOW TO APPLY



1. Start your application with the word CITRINE.

2. Send three AI-generated product or e-commerce images you made. For at least one, put the real product photo, your prompt and the raw AI output next to the finished image, so we can see how close you got to the real product.

3. Share every link so anyone with the link can open it, without signing in or requesting access. A link we cannot open counts as missing.

4. Look at 
 (our Energy Cleansing Set). In three or four sentences, tell us which image you would redo first and why.

5. Confirm you can work 4:00 pm to 8:00 pm Philippine time on weekdays, and tell us which laptop you work on (model and year).



Applications missing any of the five will not be reviewed.

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on ecommerce Google Ads specialist for a focused paid review, with the opportunity to take responsibility for ongoing management.



INITIAL PAID ASSESSMENT

We will provide existing audit findings and appropriate read-only access. Validate the priority findings, identify material omissions and recommend a practical first-month plan. Please quote a fixed price and estimated turnaround for this defined assessment.



Cover Shopping, Performance Max and Search; budget allocation and search-term waste; brand versus non-brand performance; Merchant Centre and product-feed quality; purchase conversion values, duplication and attribution across Google Ads, GTM and GA4; and profitability across brands with different margins.

ONGOING OPPORTUNITY

Manage campaigns, improve feeds and assets, monitor budgets and conversion health, and report weekly on results, changes, next actions and blockers. Diagnose tracking issues, perform agreed GTM work and specify website changes clearly for our developer.



Success means profitable growth after product costs, advertising costs and management fees, supported by reliable measurement. We want someone who can demonstrate where additional budget is justified. Budget increases require agreement with the director.



REQUIREMENTS

Proven ecommerce Google Ads results; strong Shopping, Performance Max and Merchant Centre skills; practical GTM/GA4 troubleshooting; clear written English; and experience with large catalogues and varying margins. UK ecommerce and Magento experience are advantages. Flexible remote working with occasional UK-morning calls. 



TO APPLY

title: AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property-tech, remote)
description:
Title:

AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property-tech, remote)



Role

We are looking for a strong, reliable engineer who likes to move fast with AI tools and still ships carefully. We care heavily about clear communication, good decisions, and a clean trial result.



About us

We are a European property-tech company. We maintain a long-running Laravel application with Blade, Vue 2, Bootstrap, and tenant-scoped data patterns. We use GitLab merge requests. We care about security, privacy, and small reviewable changes.



How we work

We use an AI-assisted development workflow. You are expected to use coding assistants to speed up analysis and implementation, but you treat generated output as draft work: clarify scope, plan the change, verify behaviour, keep diffs small, and prove changes with sensible and thorough checks and testing before review.



This role is a great fit if you like turning requirements into a short plan, using AI where it helps, keeping changes easy to review, and checking your work before you ask for feedback. It is not a fit if you want to ship large unreviewed blocks of AI-generated code.



What you will do

- Deliver scoped changes on a mature Laravel + Vue 2 codebase using AI-assisted methods safely.

- Open merge requests with clear descriptions, scoped commits, and tests where applicable.

- Communicate in writing about plan, trade-offs, and verification steps.



Requirements

- Demonstrable AI-assisted workflow in real product work (you can explain it concretely).

- Comfortable working in Laravel in a larger codebase, including reading and navigating existing code you did not write yourself.

- Comfortable with Vue 2 in production, or strong Vue experience with a clear plan to work within Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- Comfortable with Blade templates and web security (escaping, CSRF, safe handling of user input).

- Solid Git habits: branches, scoped commits, merge request workflow.

- Written English strong enough for async work with EU stakeholders.

- Ideally 4 to 6 hours overlap per workday with CET business hours (Monday to Friday). Please state your timezone and the CET window you can reliably cover each workday.



Nice to have

- AI-assisted work on legacy codebases (careful refactors, incremental upgrades, tenant-scoped features).

- Laravel Mix / Webpack and Docker-based local builds.

- Multi-tenant SaaS experience.



Trial (before any production access)

We run a mini-trial on a sandbox repository that mirrors our stack patterns but contains no production code or customer data. Timebox is about 4 to 6 hours, agreed upfront.



You may use AI tools during the trial, but you must not paste secrets, customer data, production logs, or private business information into external tools. You must be able to explain and defend everything you submit.



How to apply (English, no template letters)

1) Your current AI-assisted workflow: how you scope prompts, verify output, and prevent scope creep.

2) One example where an AI tool gave a wrong or risky suggestion. How did you catch it?

3) Either (A) walk us through one concrete merge request or commit you authored where AI was your primary tool: what you prompted, what came back, and what you changed before merge, or (B) if you cannot share a link, describe your first 30 minutes on an unfamiliar legacy Laravel/Vue task before you edit code.

4) How do you keep AI-assisted changes small and reviewable in a legacy monolith?

5) Multi-tenant safety: what checks would you do before changing a query that returns tenant-owned records?

6) What information must never be pasted into external AI tools? Name categories, not examples from real projects.



Do not apply if

- You are not the person who will do the work.

- You ship AI output without verification.

- You cannot describe your workflow concretely.

- You only have Vue 3 experience and cannot commit to Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- You would paste secrets, production logs, or customer data into external tools.

title: Remote Credit Controller
description:
We're hiring a part-time, remote Credit Controller to phone UK business clients about overdue invoices and agree how and when they'll pay. Our client is  an established UK accountancy firm. You'll work as part of their team and introduce yourself as our client on every call.

This is not a cold-calling sales job. Everyone you call is an existing client who already knows the firm. Your job is to find out why an invoice hasn't been paid, then turn that into a clear next step: a payment date, a payment plan by Direct Debit, or a problem passed back to the team to fix.

Everything happens in one simple web app built for this job. It gives you your list of clients to call, shows a script for every call, and records each outcome. You won't need access to the firm's accounting software, bank or payment systems.

What you'll do day to day

• Work through a daily list of clients to call. The app sets the order: callbacks and promised payment dates come first.

• Make outbound calls to UK business owners and finance contacts, following a set call script.

• Find out why each invoice is unpaid: not received, a complaint about the service, or money being tight.

• Agree a firm next step on every call: a date they'll pay by, a payment plan, or a callback time.

• Send the Direct Debit sign-up link to clients who agree a payment plan. One click in the app does this.

• Send short text or WhatsApp reminders when a client doesn't answer.

• Log the outcome of every call accurately: what happened, the reason they gave, and the follow-up date.

• Call clients back on the day you agreed, and chase promised payments that haven't arrived.

• Flag complaints and hard cases to the manager instead of trying to settle them yourself.

Requirements

• At least 1 year of outbound calling: credit control, collections, customer retention or phone sales. Calls to UK, US or Australian customers are a strong plus.

• Excellent spoken English, clear and easy for UK business owners to understand. You need to stay calm and warm even when a client is annoyed.

• Comfortable asking for a commitment. You don't hang up with "I'll think about it". You ask for a specific date and wait for the answer.

• Careful record-keeping. Every call is logged straight away with the right outcome and reason. Your notes are what the team works from.

• Able to follow a script without sounding like you're reading it.

• Available during UK business hours. Calls go out between 9am and 5pm UK time, Monday to Friday. In the Philippines that's an evening and night shift.

• A quiet place to work, a reliable internet connection (at least 10 Mbps) and a backup plan for power cuts.

• A noise-cancelling USB headset and a computer that runs Google Chrome.

• Discretion. You'll see client names and amounts owed, and they must stay confidential.

Nice to have

• Experience with accounts receivable, credit control or an accounting firm.

• Knowledge of how Direct Debit works in the UK, or of GoCardless.

• Experience with a CRM, a ticketing system or a call-centre dialer.

• Some experience handling complaints or rescuing an unhappy customer.

• Experience with a cloud softphone such as CircleLoop, Aircall or RingCentral.

Tools you'll be given

We provide two logins. You won't need the firm's accounting software, bank or payment systems.

Tool

What it's for

Credit Control Tracker (web app)

Your list of clients to call, the call script, outcome logging, texts, WhatsApp and Direct Debit links

CircleLoop (softphone in the browser)

Making calls from a UK business number through your headset

You'll get full training: a written staff manual, a walkthrough, and supervised practice calls before you go live.

Hours, pay and how success is measured

• Hours: 20 hours a week, Monday to Friday, within 9am to 5pm UK time. In the Philippines that's about 5pm to 1am in the UK winter and 4pm to midnight in the UK summer. Set times will be agreed.

• Pay: $6.75 USD per hour (about $600 a month at 20 hours a week), paid twice a month through OnlineJobs.ph. Bonuses are possible for strong performance.

• Trial: a paid 2-week trial, then an ongoing role.

Your performance is measured from what the app records, so it's fair and visible to you too:

Measure

What good looks like

Calls made and outcomes logged

Every working day, with no call left unlogged

Promises to pay kept

Clients you agree a date with actually pay by that date

Clients with no outcome

This number falls week on week until every client has a clear status

Money recovered

Rises month on month

Accurate records

The outcome, reason and notes match what happened on the call

How to apply

Applications without a voice note won't be considered.

title: Google Business Profile Specialist (Junior Local SEO)
description:
DON'T apply if you can't commit to working 9am-5pm US EST hours!



About the role

Sustain Media is a local SEO and Google Ads agency for home service businesses like plumbers, HVAC companies, roofers, and electricians. We're hiring a full-time Google Business Profile specialist to own posting for every client profile we manage.



Your job is to make sure every profile gets good posts twice a week, every week. Our AI tools do most of the heavy lifting. We need a sharp person to pick the right photos, check every post, and make sure it goes live on time. Our clients look at their profiles, so a missed week gets noticed.



What you'll do

- Go through each client's photo folder and pick the best job photos for that week's posts.

- Use our Claude setup to turn those photos into branded post graphics with the client's logo and a keyword.

- Use our Claude setup to write the post copy from each client's brief. Posts run about 350 characters and are written for local search.

- Check every graphic and every post before it goes live, including the logo, business name, city, and service.

- Schedule the posts directly in each Google Business Profile, twice a week per profile.

- Follow the direction our SEO team sets for each client, like pushing a seasonal service or a new city.

- From time to time, respond to Google reviews on client profiles.

- Send a short weekly report on what got posted for each client, anything that slipped, and anything you need from us.





What you need

- Hands-on experience managing Google Business Profiles, including posts, photos, and profile updates.

- A good eye for photos. You can tell a clean job photo from a blurry one, and you won't post anything that makes a client look bad.

- You're really comfortable using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT and following a written process step by step.

- Strong written English.

- You catch small mistakes, like the wrong logo or a city that doesn't match the profile. You care about the details.

- You're reliable. Posts go out on time every week without anyone chasing you.



Nice to have

- Experience with home service businesses in the US, like HVAC, plumbing, roofing, or electrical.

- Local SEO experience and a real interest in learning more of it.

- Some Airtable experience. Client briefs live there.



Pay and schedule

- $900 to 1,200 USD per month, paid every other Friday.

- Ability to work 9-5am EST. Full time, 40 hours a week, remote.



This is a full-time role. If you're working other jobs during your hours with us, this isn't the right fit.



How to apply

Send us these three things. Applications without a Loom video won't be reviewed.

1. A 2 to 3 minute Loom video. Introduce yourself, then pull up any local business's Google Business Profile and tell us what you'd post for them this week and why.

2. Put "Twice a week" in your message to us so we know you read the whole post. 

3. Your resume.

, Instagram, and TikTok

We are an established private healthcare clinic in the United Kingdom looking for an experienced, highly organised and proactive Medical Practice Operations Manager / Virtual Assistant.



This is a long-term position for someone with previous experience in healthcare practice administration, medical billing and financial administration.



We are not looking for a general virtual assistant who simply completes tasks when instructed.



We are looking for someone who can take full operational ownership of our clinic’s administration, financial processes and diary management, ensuring the business runs efficiently and that important tasks are completed without constant supervision.



You will work directly with the clinic owner and become the main administrative point of contact for the business.



Key Responsibilities



1. Financial Management, Medical Billing & Reconciliation



You will take responsibility for the clinic’s day-to-day financial administration.



Responsibilities include:



* Managing invoicing and billing through Cliniko.

* Processing and submitting medical insurance claims.

* Managing UK private health insurance portals.

* Monitoring outstanding invoices and unpaid claims.

* Investigating rejected insurance claims and arranging corrections or resubmissions.

* Reconciling insurer remittances against invoices.

* Reconciling bank receipts against payments recorded in Cliniko.

* Managing bookkeeping processes within Xero.

* Preparing weekly and monthly financial administration reports.

* Liaising with the clinic owner and external accountant when required.



The expectation is that you will take ownership of these processes from beginning to end, rather than simply assisting with individual tasks.



Financial approval, authorisation of payments and final accounting decisions will remain with the clinic owner and accountant.



2. Complete Diary & Appointment Management



You will take responsibility for maintaining and managing the clinic’s appointment diaries.



This includes:



* Managing bookings, cancellations and rescheduling.

3.
 & Telephone Administration

 inbox.

s.

 management.

description:

 and automated calling. Warmed domains, clear opt-out, and consent where it is required. Compliance and deliverability are part of the job, not an afterthought.

title: Technical QA Engineer (Laravel + Vue 2, post-deploy), EU property-tech + SaaS, remote
description:
Role

We ship small changes to our live platforms often. We want a technical QA engineer with a real developer background: you think like a user, but you can also read the code path, review merge requests, and tell us when the fix or the AI-suggested change should be different. After each release you check that landlords, renters, candidates and companies can still get from A to B to C. You are not the person who builds features full time, but you are close to a half-developer on our stack. Speed and quality, not one at the cost of the other.



About us

We are a European property-tech company. We run several live rental and property platforms on one shared Laravel and Vue 2 codebase, plus a recruitment SaaS where candidates record video intakes for companies and agencies. We use GitLab merge requests. We care about security, privacy, and small reviewable changes.



Where you sit in our flow

We roll out to production often and we want to keep that pace. Developers deploy; you are not a gate before release and you do not own the deploy button. After each production rollout you test on
 the journeys that release touched, then the critical paths users depend on, on desktop and mobile, with test accounts and safe paths where we need them. You are the second check after go-live, not a blocker in front of it. When something fails for a real user, you report it fast with steps, expected versus actual, and enough detail that a developer can fix it the same day.



How we work

Our developers work with AI coding assistants and keep their changes small. You test the outcome in the browser and you sanity-check the change in GitLab: read the diff, spot risky patterns, and push back when generated code is sloppy or the wrong layer was touched. If something works on paper but feels wrong in the browser, you say so. You may use AI tools yourself, but the pass or fail comes from what you verified, not from what the model claimed.



What you will do

- After each production rollout, smoke-test the journeys that release touched, on desktop and on mobile

- Re-run the critical journeys per product: listing a property, booking a viewing, uploading documents, recording a video intake, reviewing candidates

- Explore beyond the release note when something looks fragile

- Check that a change on one platform did not break or leak into another platform on the same codebase

- Write clear bug reports: steps to reproduce, expected versus actual, severity, environment, browser and device, screenshot or short video

- Point developers to the file, layer, or request: Blade, Vue component, controller, query, or API response

- Give UX feedback in plain words, for example "a landlord would not know what to do here"

- Review merge requests and recent commits: what changed, what could regress, what should have been tested, what you would do differently

- Suggest concrete improvements to developers (and to AI-generated patches): safer query, clearer validation, better error handling, smaller scope



Requirements

- Strong technical background: you have worked as a developer or as QA embedded with developers, and you can read Laravel and Vue 2 code in a real codebase, not only tutorials

- Hands-on experience with Laravel web applications and Vue 2 front ends in production, or equivalent depth with a similar PHP plus SPA stack and a clear plan to work in our Vue 2 patterns

- Experience with multi-brand or multi-tenant products: one codebase, several sites or customers, and you know how a fix on one brand can break another

- Proven QA on live web products, with examples where your report or your review caught something others missed

- You think in user journeys and in the people behind them

- Clear written English, short and precise

- Solid GitLab or GitHub habits: branches, merge requests, reading diffs, commenting on specific lines

- Browser developer tools: console, network tab, status codes; you tie UI symptoms to backend responses

- Comfortable challenging AI-assisted development: you review output like a senior teammate, not like a checklist-only tester

- Reliable and self-directed: you find the next useful check without being told

- This role is QA and review first. We do not hire you primarily to ship features. Occasional tiny fixes are a bonus, not the job description.



Nice to have

- Accessibility basics: keyboard use, contrast, readable forms

- Ideas for light automated checks or regression notes, without making automation the whole role

- Docker-based local setup or Laravel Mix familiarity



Working hours: full time, 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 17:00 Amsterdam time. That is 15:00 to 23:00 in the Philippines in European summer, and 16:00 to 00:00 when Europe switches to winter time. Please state your timezone and the window you can reliably cover each workday.



Paid trial (before full engagement)

A paid trial week of about five working days, full time, at $3 per hour, tracked with TimeProof after signing. We give you test accounts, a short list of recent rollouts to verify the same way you would after go-live, and read-only visibility on merge requests where useful. You test like a real user on desktop and mobile, file bug reports and UX notes, and add technical review comments where you see risk in the change. You may use AI tools, but you must not paste secrets, customer data, production logs, or private business information into external tools. You must be able to explain and defend everything you report and every review comment.



The deal

Remote, full time, long term. Hours are tracked with TimeProof. Rate: $3 per hour to start, reviewed on quality and impact. This is a long-term role, not a one-off project.



How to apply (English, no template letters)

1) Start your message with ABC.

2) One bug you found in production that others missed: how you reproduced it and how you reported it.

3) How you would test a release right after it goes live, without slowing every release down.

4) One example of UX feedback you gave that changed a flow.

5) A form submits and nothing happens. What do you send the developer?

6) One merge request or diff you reviewed: what you looked at in the code, what you worried about, and what you asked the developer to change.

7) Your timezone and the Amsterdam-time window you can cover.



Keep it short. Selected applicants do a short video intake on our platform before we talk.



Do not apply if

- You are not the person who will do the work

- You only know QA in theory and cannot give real examples

- You have never read application code or merge request diffs in a real job

- You only write automated tests and do not think about the people using the product

- You want a pure development role with no testing responsibility

- You cannot write clear English

- You would paste secrets, production logs, or customer data into external tools
